Their consultants work with industry-leading organizations in some of the world's most dynamic market sectors, where effective compensation programs and human capital management are critical drivers of success. The firm is expanding its Data Strategy function to support continued growth of its internal data platform and broader initiatives spanning data engineering, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities. Position Summary This is a hands-on Data Engineering role focused on building, maintaining, and expanding the firm's internal data platform. The position reports directly to the Director of Data Strategy, with a dotted-line relationship to the Lead Data Engineer / Developer. The engineering team is intentionally small, giving this individual meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence how the platform evolves. The successful candidate will work closely with the Lead Data Engineer while taking on core data engineering responsibilities across data ingestion, pipelines, modeling, warehousing, database performance, and data quality. The environment is primarily on-premises and built around  Python, PostgreSQL, and Linux . Candidates coming from cloud environments are welcome, but must be comfortable working within an on-premises environment long-term. The organization is continuing to expand its use of data, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled technologies to improve internal workflows and make information more accessible and reusable across the business. Responsibilities Build, maintain, and expand data models, ingestion processes, pipelines, and datasets. Design and support reliable ETL/ELT workflows with an emphasis on performance, stability, data quality, and auditability. Develop and maintain data warehouse structures, views, and models supporting reporting, analytics, and data exploration. Work extensively with PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexes, views, materialized views, functions, and other server-side database objects. Monitor and improve database and pipeline performance, reliability, and data quality. Support secure handling of sensitive data and established data security, governance, and compliance requirements. Participate in technical code reviews and engineering quality practices. Partner directly with internal business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions. Contribute to technical architecture and broader Data Strategy decisions as the platform continues to evolve. Support data infrastructure and integrations associated with emerging AI-enabled capabilities. Collaborate closely with the Lead Data Engineer / Developer, bringing technical perspective, constructive feedback, and independent problem-solving. Maintain technical documentation and contribute to ongoing platform support and continuous improvement. Support production and maintenance work that must be performed after normal business hours, including monthly Saturday patching activities. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional data engineering or closely related engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. Strong  Python  development skills. Strong  SQL  skills and hands-on experience working with relational databases. Hands-on  PostgreSQL  experience, including database performance and query optimization. Experience developing and maintaining data models and data warehouse structures. Experience working in  Linux  environments. Ability to independently troubleshoot technical and data-related issues. Ability to work directly with business stakeholders and end users to understand requirements without relying exclusively on a Business Analyst or Project Manager. Ability to explain technical concepts and decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working within an on-premises environment; candidates seeking a cloud-only role will not be a fit. Comfortable working within a small engineering team where engineers have meaningful ownership and are expected to bring ideas, ask questions, and challenge approaches when appropriate. Must permanently reside in the United States and be authorized to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience working with on-premises or internally managed data infrastructure. Experience with cloud/on-premises migrations or environments incorporating both cloud and on-premises technologies. Exposure to  Django web app framework and/or FastAPI  through professional or personal projects. Experience with job orchestration, background processing, or scheduling tools such as Celery, Celery Beat, cron, or similar technologies. Broader PostgreSQL database administration or server-side development experience. Experience with Git-based development workflows and collaborative code review. Familiarity with data security concepts, including access controls, encryption, audit logging, and sensitive-data handling. Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar security/compliance frameworks. Experience preparing data or building integrations supporting AI/ML or AI-enabled applications. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools while maintaining independent technical judgment. Experience in a startup, consulting, or similarly entrepreneurial environment where engineers work directly with business stakeholders. Experience working with compensation, financial, or other highly sensitive data. Previous remote-work experience. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.    Location   NY/NJ, Columbus, Delaware   Duration   6-month assignment with the possibility of extension / conversion to FTE   We are seeking a skilled developer with strong experience in React and Python to support the development of a custom application for entitlement management, access policy automation, workflow integration, and data governance capabilities. The candidate will work as part of a delivery team focused on building scalable, secure, and automated solutions for HR data entitlement enforcement across enterprise platforms.   Key Responsibilities     Design, develop, and enhance custom web applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, and Python.   Build backend services, REST APIs, and integration components to support entitlement workflows, role management, and policy automation.   Develop user interfaces in React for administration, approval workflows, data dictionary management, and access request tracking.   Create Python-based automation scripts for data validation, policy mapping, workflow orchestration, and integration with enterprise tools.   Support integration with IAM systems, Active Directory groups, ServiceNow workflows, data platforms, and entitlement/policy tools.   Implement secure coding practices, logging, monitoring, auditability, and automated validation controls.   Collaborate with architects, QA engineers, business stakeholders, and platform teams to deliver prioritized use cases within the project timeline.     Required Skills     Strong hands-on experience in Java full stack development.   Proficiency with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.   Experience with Python scripting or application development.   Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and database integration.   Experience building enterprise workflow, data governance, access management, or policy automation applications.   Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, unit testing, and Agile delivery practices.     Understanding of security, RBAC/ABAC concepts, entitlement models, and data privacy controls is preferred.     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

The candidate will be responsible for designing| developing| and maintaining scalable web applications| collaborating with cross-functional teams| and delivering high-quality software solutions.     Key Responsibilities:  Develop and maintain scalable enterprise applications using Java| Spring Boot| and React JS. Design and develop RESTful APIs and Microservices. Build responsive and interactive user interfaces using React JS. Participate in solution design| code reviews| and technical discussions. Integrate front-end applications with backend services and databases. Write clean| reusable| and maintainable code following best practices. Perform unit testing| integration testing| and debugging. Implement security| performance optimization| and reliability standards. Work in Agile/Scrum development environments.    You will:  • design and develop scalable backend services in Java and responsive user interfaces in React  • contribute to distributed systems, cloud architecture, and microservice design  • deliver maintainable, secure, and high-quality software  • write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests  • analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions  • participate in architecture, platform design, and technical decision-making  • investigate production issues and implement sustainable improvements  • create and maintain technical documentation  Your team  You will join a cross-functional engineering team responsible for developing and supporting OneSource web services. You will work closely with engineers, architects, product stakeholders, business analysts, testers, and platform teams.  Your expertise  You bring:  • strong backend development experience with Java, Spring Framework / Spring Batch / Spring Boot  • experience with Cloud native technology (Microservices, container technology) and DevOps  • strong frontend development experience with React, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS  • experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices  • a solid understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture  • experience with relational databases (Sybase or MSSQL, Oracle), data modeling, and strong SQL skills  • strong automated testing and software-quality practices  • accustomed with Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)  • knowledge of Git, CI/CD, secure coding, and production support  • experience analyzing business requirements and documenting technical solutions  • strong ownership, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills  Experience with Client Azure, containerized platforms, Kubernetes, event-driven systems, observability tools, and large client-facing applications would be an advantage.     Mandatory Skills:  Backend Java 8/11/17Spring BootSpring MVC Spring Security Microservices Architecture REST API Development Hibernate / JPA Maven / Gradle Frontend React JS Java Script (ES6+)TypeScriptHTML5CSS3Bootstrap / Material UIRedux / Context API Database SQL Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL DevOps & Tools Git/GitHub/GitLab Jenkins / CI-CD Docker Kubernetes     Good to have:  Sonar Qube Cloud (Preferred)Azure / AWS Azure DevOps  Kafka / RabbitMQGraphQLTerraformOpenShiftOAuth2 / JWT Authentication Performance tuning and monitoring tools     Experience Required:  6-8

skills.source: plaintext JOB SUMMARY Supports the organization’s digital strategy and business operations by designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining secure, scalable web and mobile applications that improve the experience of members and employees. This role builds and supports internal and external digital platforms—including public websites, intranet, extranet, and digital banking applications—using Optimizely CMS/Commerce (DXP) and Microsoft technologies such as C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, WCF, Razor, and ADO.NET, along with modern front-end frameworks including JavaScript, ReactJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. Working in an Agile environment, the position collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, participate in architecture and design discussions, develop reusable components and APIs, integrate backend systems and databases (SQL Server and Oracle), and ensure applications meet performance, security, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities .NET Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade websites and applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC, with preferred experience in Optimizely CMS/Commerce and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Build and support enterprise applications using n-tier architecture and established design patterns within the Microsoft technology stack. Front-End Development & User Experience: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, ReactJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, and CSS3. Collaborate with UX designers and stakeholders to deliver intuitive digital experiences. Utilize design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to support UI/UX design validation, usability testing, and iterative design improvements. API Development & Systems Integration: Design and implement SOAP and RESTful APIs using Microsoft technologies including WCF and ASP.NET Web API. Integrate applications with backend systems and services using .NET, OLE DB, and other enterprise data access technologies. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable system integrations across internal and external platforms. Database Development & Data Modeling: Collaborate with database developers to support data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization. Contribute to database development tasks using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle as required. Agile Development & Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Manage development activities using Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, or other enterprise project management tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing and IT— including Project Management, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administration—as well as onsite and offshore resources to ensure successful solution delivery, alignment with business objectives, and ongoing operational support. Testing, Optimization & Development Standards: Perform unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and code refactoring to ensure high-quality and maintainable software. Adhere to organizational coding standards, documentation requirements, and secure development practices. Maintain accurate task tracking, code changes, and version control using Git or other enterprise source control systems. Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Ensure applications meet availability, reliability, and performance standards in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Provide troubleshooting and technical support for application-related issues and user requests. Serve as backup administrator for Windows-based web servers when required. Security, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure compliance with organizational policies related to data protection, cybersecurity, network security, and antivirus standards. Maintain accurate service records, system documentation, configuration documentation, and knowledge base articles. Contribute to operational documentation and system runbooks supporting application environments. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science Knowledge of financial/banking industry 3+ years of software development experience on the Microsoft technology stack. 3+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and ADO.NET. 3+ years of front-end development experience building responsive and interactive user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap (or similar frameworks). Experience designing and implementing user-centric web applications, with a strong focus on usability and overall UI/UX experience. 3+ years of database development experience using T-SQL with Microsoft SQL Server. 2+ years of experience developing and consuming web services and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP using Web API or WCF. Preferred Qualifications Experience illustrating design concepts through storyboards, workflow diagrams, wireframes, and UI mockup Experience implementing complex business workflows and enterprise application logic. Knowledge of secure application development practices, including implementing security controls in .NET applications and web servers. Familiarity with modern front-end development tools Experience developing solutions using Optimizely CMS/Commerce or Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

skills.source: Role : C/c++ Software Engineer    Location :   Owego, NY 13827  (Onsite)    Employment type : Contract          Core Responsibilities:    • Design & Development Write, debug, and maintain modern C++ code for secure processing applications. Develop and sustain legacy codebases used across multiple projects. Implement low‑level C/C++ for bare‑metal and RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, VxWorks).    • Embedded & Firmware Integration Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate software with microcontrollers, ASICs, and FPGA subsystems (Xilinx, PolarFire). Produce firmware, drivers, and hardware‑abstraction layers for mission‑critical platforms.    • CI/CD & Build Automation Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) to streamline builds, tests, and deployments. Use build systems such as CMake or Make; script automation with Python, Bash, or PowerShell.    • Quality & Compliance Enforce coding standards (MISRA C/C++, C++ Core Guidelines). Conduct peer reviews, unit‑testing (GoogleTest), and maintain comprehensive test suites.    • Documentation & Communication Create clear design documents, interface specifications, and maintenance guides. Participate in Agile ceremonies (stand‑ups, sprint planning, retrospectives). Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across cross‑functional teams.       			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Job Title: Java Backend Developer  Job Location: Columbus, OH   Job Description:    We are seeking a skilled Java Backend Developer with strong expertise in Spring Framework to design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems. The ideal candidate will have a passion for clean code, robust architecture, and delivering high-quality software solutions.   Key Responsibilities     Develop and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.   Design RESTful APIs and integrate with front-end applications and third-party services.   Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams (front-end, QA, DevOps) to deliver end-to-end solutions.   Implement security and data protection best practices.   Write unit and integration tests to ensure code quality.   Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.   Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems.     Required Skills & Qualifications     Strong proficiency in Java (Java 8 ).   Hands-on experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security).   Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.   Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).   Familiarity with version control systems (Git).   Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.   Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile environment.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with Docker/Kubernetes for containerization.   Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ).   Exposure to test-driven development (TDD).   Understanding of DevOps practices.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I.   Location:  Seattle, WA.         Job Description:     Client Payment Products team is looking for developers to design and build next generation global payments solutions that revolutionize the way customers pay. The Client Payments Team manages all Client branded payment offerings, globally.    These offerings are growing rapidly and we are continuously adding new market-leading features and launching new products. Our payments products (Client Co-Branded Credit Cards, Private Labeled Credit Cards, Non-Client Branded Credit Cards, Shop with Points and Foreign Exchange) provide the most innovative payment experience on and off Client.   As we build innovative payments solutions for our customers, the role provides a huge opportunity for the developers to build a strong portfolio of patents for Client. The role will also include defining and implementing extensible, multi-faceted solutions that support global and region specific payments specific protocols and workflows. This is a critical program for Consumer Payments, with high leadership visibility, and opportunity for delivering significant business value.   We are looking for passionate, experienced software developers that can lead a team of developers in delivering high quality software solutions to support variety of customer use cases and are scalable to handle Client volume.   Developers in the team need a strong understanding of Computer fundamentals and practical experience in building full stack, large scale distributed systems. Experience with web-based applications and/or web services-based applications, especially at massive scale, is also helpful.     Key job responsibilities:     Develop and maintain backend services.   Create and optimize rendering solutions for multiple channels.   Design and develop APIs for system integration.   Write clean, maintainable code following best practices.   Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms.   Optimize system performance for high-traffic applications.   Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.                       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

In this role, you will focus on building robust server-side logic, developing secure APIs, and managing data persistence layers. You will collaborate closely with frontend engineers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver scalable microservices that power our core business platforms.  ________________________________________  Key Responsibilities  •System Design: Architect and scale distributed backend systems that handle high traffic, concurrency, and data throughput.  •API persistence using ORM frameworks.  •Security & Auth: Implement and maintain robust security protocols for authentication and authorization.  •Testing Automation: Write comprehensive unit, integration, and regression test suites to ensure high code quality.  •CI/CD & Cloud: Package applications into containers and assist in deploying services to cloud infrastructure.  •Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance, memory leaks, and query bottlenecks.  ________________________________________  Required Skills & Qualifications  •System Design: Proven experience with distributed systems design, load balancing, caching strategies, and system scalability.  •Data Structures & Algorithms: Strong foundational knowledge of data structures (trees, graphs, hash maps) and algorithms to write highly efficient code.  •Core Python: Deep knowledge of Python 3.10+, handling async programming (asyncio), and memory management.  •Python Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with modern web frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask.  •Databases: Strong proficiency in relational databases (SQLserver, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ORM/ODM tools (SQLAlchemy, Django ORM).  •API Design: Proven experience designing clean RESTful web services and integrating with third-party systems.  •Build & Test Tools: Daily experience using dependency managers like Poetry or Pipenv, alongside testing tools like Pytest and unittest.  •Version Control: Mastery of Git for branching, merging, and pull requests." skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Machine Learning Engineer   Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.       Key Responsibilities:     Design, build, and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines for data prep, training, validation, packaging, and deployment.   Develop FastAPI microservices for model inference with clear API contracts, versioning, and documentation.   Define and implement deployment strategies on AKS (blue/green, canary, shadow; champion/challenger) using GitOps with Argo CD.   Architect and evolve a self-serve MLOps platform (standards, templates, CLI/scaffolds) enabling repeatable, secure model delivery.   Operationalize scikit-learn and other frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, XGBoost) for low-latency, scalable serving.   Implement CI/CD for ML (test, security scan, build, package, promote) using GitHub Enterprise and related tooling.   Integrate telemetry and observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and establish SLOs for model services.   Monitor model and data drift; automate retraining, evaluation, and safe rollout/rollback workflows.   Collaborate with software engineers to integrate ML services into client applications and shared platforms.   Champion best practices for code quality, reproducibility, and governance (model registry, artifacts, approvals).            Required Qualifications:     Strong Python engineering skills and production experience building services with FastAPI.   Proven MLOps experience: packaging, serving, scaling, and maintaining models as APIs.   Hands-on CI/CD for ML (GitHub Enterprise or similar), including automated testing and release pipelines.   Containerization and orchestration expertise (Docker, Kubernetes) with production deployments on AKS.   GitOps experience with Argo CD; practical knowledge of deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rollback).   Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices patterns, and API contract governance.   Experience designing or contributing to an MLOps platform (standards, templates, tooling) for repeatable delivery.   Ability to work cross-functionally with data scientists, software, and platform/SRE teams.       Preferred Qualifications:     Minimum 2+ years related experience.   Experience with ML lifecycle tools (MLflow or similar for tracking/registry) and feature stores.   Exposure to Databricks and enterprise data/compute environments.   Cloud experience on Azure (preferred), plus GCP familiarity and managed ML services.   Familiarity with Agile practices; experience with Helm/Kustomize, secrets management, and security scanning.              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Role Details   Location: Remote   Type: Fulltime   Key Responsibilities     Develop responsive frontend applications using ReactJS (Hooks, state management) to support backend-driven features.   Integrate AI and LLM-powered capabilities into backend services, including agentic workflows and tool-calling patterns.   Apply MCP (Model Context Protocol) concepts to connect AI agents with backend services, APIs, and data sources.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams on API contracts, data flows, and end-to-end feature delivery.   Design and develop scalable, production-grade backend services using Python frameworks (FastAPI / Flask / Django).   Architect, build, and integrate RESTful APIs and backend microservices with strong attention to performance, reliability, and security.   Design and optimize relational database structures using PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQL Server — including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and data modeling.   Implement robust authentication and authorization frameworks beyond basic JWT — including OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, SSO integrations, session management, token lifecycle (refresh/rotation/revocation), and role-based / attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC).     Must-Have Skills     AI / Agentic AI / MCP: Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals, agentic AI architectures (planning, tool use, multi-step workflows), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent–system integration; familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain / LangGraph is a strong plus.   Python Backend (Primary): Strong, hands-on experience building backend services with FastAPI / Flask / Django — async patterns, dependency injection, middleware, API versioning, testing, and production deployment.   Databases: Deep practical experience with PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQL Server — complex queries, joins, indexing, transactions, ORM usage (SQLAlchemy / Django ORM), and performance tuning.   Authentication & Security: Demonstrated depth in auth frameworks beyond JWT basics — OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO, RBAC, secure session handling, and API security best practices.   RESTful APIs: Proven experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and backend services at scale.   ReactJS (Secondary): Hands-on expertise with ReactJS — Hooks, component lifecycle, and state management (Redux / Context API).     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

Integrate applications with relational and NoSQL databases.  Develop reusable components and services following best practices. Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize scalability.  Ensure security, reliability, and compliance standards are met.  Collaborate in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and estimation.   Appreciate your quick response and please feel free to reach me out for any query you may have.     Thanks

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title: Software Engineer - II/ .Net Developer   Location:  Atlanta, GA 30326 or Oklahoma City, OK 73132, or Cincinnati, OH 45249 – 3 days onsite   Duration:  9 months assignment with the possibility of extension   Job Description:    Client, a leader in payment technology, is seeking an experienced  Software Engineer II  to join our Paymetric Engineering team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development of highly transactional, cloud-based microservices and solutions, with a strong emphasis on tokenization and encryption for the payments/fintech industry.   This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.   Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and maintain backend services using .NET and .NET Core, with a focus on high-transaction payment platforms.   Build and optimize cloud-based microservices in AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.   Work closely with engineering leads and managers to articulate and implement solutions for complex problems, including the ability to write and explain pseudocode.   Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the software development lifecycle using Agile methodologies.   Contribute to the ongoing improvement of engineering processes and best practices within the team.   Participate in code reviews and collaborate with team members to deliver robust, maintainable software solutions.     Required Qualifications:     3-5 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in FINTECH or payments platforms.   Proficiency in .NET and .NET Core.   Experience with cloud development, especially AWS and AWS databases.   Strong backend development experience in high-transaction environments (front-end/UI experience is not required).   Demonstrated ability to write and troubleshoot code, including the ability to explain solution approaches and pseudocode clearly.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience with microservices architecture.   Familiarity with Docker and containerization.   Working knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases.   Experience with Git for version control.   Exposure to Kubernetes orchestration.   Knowledge of C/C++ (a plus).   Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity).     Selection Process:     Coding Assessment:  Candidates will be required to complete a Hackerrank test.   Interview Rounds:     Interview with the manager   Technical interview with Software Engineering leads   Final round interview with QA and Scrum Master             Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Python Developer     Location(s):  Richmond, VA       Job Description:     We are looking for a passionate Python Developer to join our team.   You will be responsible for developing and implementing high-quality software solutions, creating complex applications using cutting-edge programming features and frameworks and collaborating with other teams in the firm to define, design and ship new features.   As an active part of our company, you will brainstorm and chalk out solutions to suit our requirements and meet our business goals. You will also be working on data engineering problems and building data pipelines. You would get ample opportunities to work on challenging and innovative projects, using the latest technologies and tools.   If you enjoy working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role. We offer industry-standard compensation packages, relocation assistance, and professional growth and development opportunities.     Objectives of this role     Develop, test and maintain high-quality software using Python programming language.   Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and solve complex problems.   Write clean and reusable code that can be easily maintained and scaled.   Create large-scale data processing pipelines to help developers build and train Client machine learning algorithms.   Participate in code reviews, ensure code quality and identify areas for improvement to implement practical solutions.   Debugging codes when required and troubleshooting any Python-related queries.   Keep up to date with emerging trends and technologies in Python development.     Required skills and qualifications     3+ years of experience as a Python Developer with a strong portfolio of projects.   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.   Strong expertise with Python, AWS, Stepfunctions, Lambda.   In-depth understanding of the Python software development stacks, ecosystems, frameworks and tools such as Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Dask, spaCy, NLTK, sci-kit-learn and PyTorch.   Experience with front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.   Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL and NoSQL.   Excellent problem-solving ability with solid communication and collaboration skills.     Preferred skills and qualifications     Experience with popular Python frameworks such as Django, Flask or Pyramid.   Knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts and tools.   Contributions to open-source Python projects or active involvement in the Python community.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python / JavaScript
skills.source: Strong programming skills in Python and JavaScript, with solid experience in at least one of: Java, PowerShell, or C#; comfortable switching across languages and technology stacks to contribute to multiple active projects simultaneously. Hands-on experience developing automation and security workflows, dedicating a significant portion of time to building software and integrations for data protection initiatives. Strong experience with Endpoint. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python and PowerShell for task automation, system administration, security operations workflows, and integration with enterprise platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure). Manage DLP tools, including configuring policies, tuning, testing, and implementing new features and functionality. Provide support across multiple areas of data security and operations: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data minimization, data discovery, cloud data protection, Privileged Access Management (PAM), data privacy, data labeling, data classification and rights management, data encryption, and data access governance. Manage the technical configuration, implementation, administration, and support of multiple data security products and solutions such as CASB, SASE, DLP, and DSPM. Develop technical documentation (e.g., system designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, functional specifications). Leverage APIs to collect key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for data governance and protection controls. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams including Security Operations, Legal, Privacy, Data and Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Platform teams, and sector functions. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) to deploy and operate security and data protection solutions. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools to accelerate delivery and maintenance of security capabilities. Experience using data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker, QuickSight) to create dashboards and insights for KPIs and KRIs related to data security. Ability to analyze security telemetry and operational data to generate actionable insights that drive program decisions and risk mitigation strategies. Solid background and understanding of security concepts such as data classification, data loss prevention (DLP) strategies , data discovery, data masking, rights management, data residency, cloud data protection, and regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PCI-DSS). 3+ years in data security, data loss prevention (DLP), software development, or computer engineering; or master's degree in computer science/engineering or related data security field, and 1 year of relevant experience.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.source: Location: Chicago, IL - need local candidates only   Salary Range: 40-45/hr on W2   Introduction   Client is seeking Software Engineers to join its enterprise CI/CD and Developer Tooling organization. The team is responsible for managing and supporting CI/CD tooling used by engineering teams across the enterprise. This is a backend-focused software engineering and platform engineering role involving development, automation, cloud infrastructure tooling, CI/CD pipelines, troubleshooting, and internal developer support.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Strong hands-on experience with  Python  development or automation.   Experience with  AWS CDK .   Experience with  Boto3  or AWS SDKs.   Hands-on Jenkins administration or operational management experience.   Experience with  Groovy  and Jenkins Pipeline.   Experience with  TypeScript .   Experience with  Java or Go .   Experience with  Docker  and containerized applications.   Experience with  Amazon ECS .   Experience with  AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and Fargate .   Experience with  Terraform  or other Infrastructure as Code tools.   Experience supporting enterprise developer platforms or internal engineering tools.   Experience with vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and software/platform upgrades.   Experience working with  AWS  cloud services.   Hands-on experience with  Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .   Strong understanding of  CI/CD concepts and deployment pipelines .   Experience with  Jenkins .   Experience developing or supporting backend applications, automation tools, or developer platforms.   Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.   Ability to work across multiple technologies and learn new tools quickly.   Strong communication and collaboration skills.   Must have previous client experience working for this customer in the past 5 years.     Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and software/platform upgrades.   Experience working with  AWS  cloud services.   Hands-on experience with  Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design, develop, enhance, and maintain software components supporting enterprise CI/CD platforms. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Request ID: 109156-1  Title: AI-Native Software Engineer  Location: San Jose CA or Raleigh NC (onsite)  Duration: 6 months  Pay Range: $45 - $50/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    JOB DESCRIPTION:      Responsibilities:  You have proven experience serving as a software engineer for web application projects, hosted On-Prem and Cloud, supporting a large customer base.  You know when to build and when to reach for a managed AWS service you can justify that trade-off based on the problem.  You think in systems and evaluate designs critically whether reviewing AI-generated code or your own architecture catching the subtle bug, security gap, or design choice that won't hold up under load or misuse.  You use spec-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software.  You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact.  You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind.  You are decisive without being divisive you can analytically weigh trade-offs, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions that span organizational boundaries.  You have excellent communication and organization skills.      Minimum Qualifications:  BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.  Demonstrated fluency in leveraging AI technologies across the entire software development lifecycle, including breaking down user stories into actionable tasks, AI-assisted coding and  testing, automated defect resolution, and deployment of fully tested software.  Deep, hands-on experience building and deploying production systems on AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, API Gateway), with a record of real, customer-facing applications running in production.  Server-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies.  Expertise in building secure, large-scale systems using fault-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB & Kafka).  AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) and/or CISSP/CCSP or similar security certification useful, not required.        Company Benefits & Culture  Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment  Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies  Supportive and collaborative work culture      Appreciate your quick response and please feel free to reach me out for any query you may have.      Thanks

skills.source: Request ID: 109156-1  Title: AI-Native Software Engineer  Location: San Jose CA or Raleigh NC (onsite)  Duration: 6 months  Pay Range: $45 - $50/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    JOB DESCRIPTION:      Responsibilities:  You have proven experience serving as a software engineer for web application projects, hosted On-Prem and Cloud, supporting a large customer base.  You know when to build and when to reach for a managed AWS service you can justify that trade-off based on the problem.  You think in systems and evaluate designs critically whether reviewing AI-generated code or your own architecture catching the subtle bug, security gap, or design choice that won't hold up under load or misuse.  You use spec-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software.  You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact.  You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind.  You are decisive without being divisive you can analytically weigh trade-offs, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions that span organizational boundaries.  You have excellent communication and organization skills.      Minimum Qualifications:  BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or demonstrated equivalent experience. Deep, hands-on experience building and deploying production systems on AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, API Gateway), with a record of real, customer-facing applications running in production.  Server-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies.  Expertise in building secure, large-scale systems using fault-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB & Kafka).  AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) and/or CISSP/CCSP or similar security certification useful, not required. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.            Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer IV     Location:  Herndon, VA     Job Responsibilities:     Design, develop, implement, test, document and deploy full-stack, cloud-native, contact center-related software applications, tools, systems and services using multi-threaded programming, development in Python and React/node.js, implementing architecture patterns and design patterns, and utilizing generative AI large language models.   Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements, and translate requirements into technical specifications for robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture.   Own delivery of entire piece of system or application, and serve as technical lead on complex projects using best practice engineering standards.   Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation.         Required Qualifications:     MS or BS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, plus five years of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or related occupations of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related.         Required technical skills:     Coding proficiency in Python, and front-end development experience with Javascript/React.   Proficiency development with services such as AWS Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, AppSync, Bedrock, SageMaker, and CloudWatch.   Proficiency in developing and integrating with REST-based or GraphQL-based APIs.   Proficiency in developing infrastructure-as-code deployment solutions such as AWS CloudFormation or AWS CDK.   Experience collaborating with other developers using git repositories, including creating and managing feature branches, pull requests, code merge, and GitHib actions or equivalent.         Top 3 must-have skills:     Generative AI based coding   AWS serverless   Python and JavaScript/React         Preferred skills:     Experience with Contact Center development and telephony infrastructure.   Experience with prompt engineering for modern large language models.   Experience using modern AI-based agentic coding assistants for code development, test development, and documentation.   Track record of building successful serverless architectures following AWS Well Architected principles.              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: HTML
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Information Technology - Software Engineer.   Location:  Canton, MD.         Description:   Purpose     Responsible for design and development of sales force applications for FEP Local claim data processing systems in health care domain by understanding requirements, coding, testing, debugging applications.   The position makes sure the application develops properly with high quality products.   Primary accountability for development work takes place during the life cycle for those projects, from planning to implementation.   Provides high quality products that are reviewed and approved by the team and Bridge plans.   Provides technical oversight and supports IT project teams to deliver high quality FEP products for business needs.     Essential Functions   50% Salesforce Application development:     Develop efficient and effective productions to deliver FEP business needs.   Serve as Salesforce application developer for new development of Salesforce applications as well as enhancement of existing applications to FEP users and other application integrations.   Communicate with other team members including developer/tester/business analyst to deliver product without gaps and best performance.   Main role of development code, review code, deployment of code to upper environments and maintenance of code.   Support D2D request and debugging issue to resolve issues. Also publishes technical documents and knowledge sharing with teams.     20% Design of system/ Analysis requirement implementation to new/existing systems:     Understand requirements and current systems well so develop systems properly based on requirement and resolution for fixing an issue/enhancement.   Study and understanding new features and services from Salesforce and each Salesforce release so that FEP salesforce applications be implements better performance of process and services.     20% Testing/Technical Support:     Develop Unit testing code and support automation testing implementation for delivery of high quality of code.   Perform troubleshooting and debugging an issue and analysis of issue and provide best resolution to teams. Supporting D2D as well as developments to different environments.     10% Collaborate to drive business value:     Work closely with other development team members, the project manager, and product managers to ensure applications to be developing properly with requirement and needs, also deliver it in time with high quality of products.     Qualifications:     Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related IT field or equivalent work experience   Required Minimum Qualifications: 1 Year of experience in building, deploying and supporting sales force applications and platform solutions.     Preferred Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field preferred.   Experience with Salesforce application development.   Experience with web programming including HTML, CSS and JavaScript.   Experience of custom solutions on Salesforce platform working with Lightning Web Components, Apex Triggers, Apex Classes, Flow, Visualforce, SOQL.   Experience building REST APIs for external systems integrations.   Experience with object-oriented programming design patterns and Salesforce data modeling best practices.   Experience developing reporting and dashboards in Salesforce.   Experience with JIRA or Agile platform for collaborating with multiple teams and source control system like Git/SVN.   Excellent verbal and written communication skills.   Excellent presentation skills with the ability to collaborate with team members and business stakeholders.   Experience in multi-cloud architecture and AWS cloud development is a plus.   Experience in a call center setup within Salesforce is plus.   Experience working with CI/CD pipelines like Copado and knowledgeable are plus.   Understanding & knowledge of AI is a plus.   Agentforce 360 experience & knowledge is a plus.   Development using AI tools like Agentforce DX, Agentforce vibes are a plus.   Data 360 experience or knowledge is a plus.   Integration with other SAAS systems is a plus.                 Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

Monitoring and supporting high volume web service integrations.     - Experience in developing responsive web design, and cross-browsers compatibility.     - Managing time effectively to work on multiple project timelines simultaneously in a demanding deadline driven environment.     - Hands-on experience with source control system such as Accurev, Maven, Git Candidate should be able to apply commonly used integration patterns and should be self-sufficient to independently develop a solution given the business requirements and high-level design.     - Working experience in RMQ, JMS, Kafka - Knowledge of DBMS technologies like Oracle, PostGres, Cassandra, Redis.     - Ability to containerize and deploy applications in a Cloud environment.     - Experienced working on workflow integrations     - Experienced working on Front-end like ReactJS.     - Hands-on experience with static analysis tools such as Sonar Cube, Fortify     - Conducts unit tests, code reviews, establishes high coding standards, assesses and improves site/software performance.     - Test business processes/products across applications with an end-to-end process flow System & Network Security     - Familiarity working with projects tracking systems, such as Jira.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Request ID: 80620-1  Title: Software Engineer (Device Testing)  Locations: Cupertino, CA 95014 (5x/ week onsite)   Duration: 6 Months  Salary Range: $55 - $59/Hour on W2 (All inclusive)   Introduction   We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer in Device Testing to join our team for a 6-month contract. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in device testing and a passion for ensuring the quality of cutting-edge technologies.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Must be willing to work 5 days onsite from Cupertino, CA location.   2 years of hands-on device testing experience.   Programming and automation experience with Python and Java.   Experience with device automation frameworks including XCUI.   Ability to analyze logs and debug issues across distributed systems.   Understanding of backend services and system integrations.   Experience validating workflows involving devices, backend services, and data pipelines.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.   Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.     Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Good understanding of database connectivity and data access, connecting to data sources and SQL.   Familiarity with containerization, cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, and data pipeline technologies such as Kafka and Spark.   Strong debugging skills and ability to independently triage issues.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Execute E2E testing across devices, backend services, data pipelines, browser UI, and supporting systems.   Validate functionality of unreleased device features and server-side platform changes.   Develop, maintain, and manually test scenarios.   Investigate failures and perform root cause triage across the system stack including devices, backend services, and data pipelines.   Analyze logs and system telemetry to identify the source of issues.   Work with internal engineering teams to provide actionable defect reports with clear reproduction steps and supporting diagnostics.   Support validation of cross-system workflows involving devices, backend services, and data pipelines.     Company Benefits & Culture     Opportunity to work on innovative and cutting-edge technologies.   Collaborative and dynamic work environment.   Professional growth and development opportunities.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.    Project Overview   We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer for a consulting role to support ongoing and future projects. The consultant will be instrumental in developing and maintaining sophisticated applications using .NET Core and Python for backend development, and React or NextJS for frontend development. This role requires significant expertise in deploying applications to Azure App Services, managing code repositories via DevOps or GitHub, and utilizing Azure managed identities for secure resource access. Additionally, the candidate should have comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication.   Job Functions & Responsibilities     Develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications using .NET Core and Python.   Design and implement responsive and dynamic user interfaces using React or NextJS.   Implement RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services.   Collaborate closely with our teams and stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and translate them into detailed technical specifications.   Utilize DevOps or GitHub for efficient version control, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.   Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and reliability.   Implement and manage Azure managed identities to ensure secure access to resources.   Integrate Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication into applications to manage user identities and access securely.   Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application issues to maintain high performance and responsiveness.   Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold code quality standards and foster knowledge-sharing within the team.   Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously enhance development practices.   Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers, fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment.   Adapt to various projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Communicate effectively with clients to understand their requirements and deliver solutions that meet their business objectives.     Skills     Extensive experience in backend development using .NET Core and Python.   Advanced proficiency in frontend technologies such as React or NextJS.   Strong knowledge of RESTful API development and integration with third-party services.   Familiarity with SQL Server or other relational databases and ORM frameworks.   Deep understanding of version control systems and CI/CD pipelines, specifically using DevOps or GitHub.   Expertise in deploying and managing applications on Azure App Services.   Strong knowledge of Azure managed identities for secure and efficient resource access.   Comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication for managing user identities and access securely.   Exceptional problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.   Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.   Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.   Ability to adapt to different projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest technological advancements.     Education & Certifications     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.   Professional certifications in .NET, Python, React, Azure, or DevOps are highly desirable.   Additional certifications or specialized training in cloud computing, particularly Azure, will be considered an advantage.     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Please see job description attached!  *** is looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run the agents that automate work across our digital commerce and transformation programs. The role is hands-on and product-minded: you take a business workflow, decide where an agent genuinely helps, and deliver a governed agent that people use every day. The work is built primarily on Client's AI platform, spanning Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Client Copilot Studio and the Client 365 and Teams surfaces where our teams already work.   This is a production engineering role rather than a prototyping one. Agents you build are expected to clear the *** Agentic Framework bar before they reach users: registered in the Agent Registry, authenticated through Client Entra, authorized under least-privilege RBAC, instrumented for observability, and certified through evaluation testing. You own that path end to end, from the first system prompt and tool schema through deployment, monitoring and iteration.   You will work alongside program managers, data engineers, BI developers, solution architects and security partners, and you will spend as much time defining what good looks like as writing code. Strong candidates are comfortable with ambiguity, opinionated about evaluation, and able to explain in plain language what an agent can do, what it cannot, and how they know.  What We Look For in a Candidate  Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience.  Four or more years of software engineering experience, including at least one year building LLM-based or agent-based applications that reached production users.  Strong Python skills, with C# or TypeScript an advantage, and fluency with asynchronous APIs, REST and GraphQL, JSON schemas and Git-based workflows.  Hands-on experience with Client AI services, including Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and at least one of Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or the Client Agent Framework.  Practical retrieval-augmented generation experience covering chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search, reranking and retrieval evaluation.  Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol or comparable tool-calling and function-calling patterns, including schema design and versioning.  Demonstrated skill in prompt and context engineering, including system prompts, few-shot design and model-specific behavior.  Experience evaluating LLM systems with offline and online methods, regression suites and human review loops, and a clear point of view on what is worth measuring.  Familiarity with Client Entra ID, OAuth2 and JWT, role-based access control and API gateway patterns.  Experience with CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code and observability tooling such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights and OpenTelemetry.  Clear written communication, including the ability to explain agent behavior, limits and failure modes to partners who are not engineers.  Sound judgment about where an agent is the right answer, and the willingness to say plainly when it is not.  Also valuable  Client certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or an Azure architecture credential.  Experience with Power Platform, including Power Automate and Dataverse, or with Client Fabric and Power BI.  Telecommunications, order management, billing or business-to-business commerce domain experience.  Contributions to agent platform tooling, registries, evaluation frameworks or internal developer experience.

Advanced proficiency in  Python  and      experience with frameworks like  PyTorch ,  TensorFlow ,  LangChain ,      and  Hugging Face . Strong understanding of  Docker ,  Kubernetes ,      and  CI/CD  practices.    Excellent problem-solving skills in      high-performance computing environments.    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,      Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.               Preferred Qualifications       Experience with distributed training and      model serving at scale.    Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices.    Contributions to open-source AI projects or      research publications.

They are involved in the entire software development lifecycle, including designing software architecture, writing code, testing for quality, and deploying the software to meet customer requirements. Full-stack software engineering roles, who can develop all components of software including user interface and server side, also fall within this job function. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Title: Data Analyst II      Duration: 3 months      Location : Remote worker located in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Chicago, IL.      Only looking for W2 candidates          Partner with MDS in providing accessibility, retrievability, security and protection of data in an ethical manner.    Parter with Product Owners, BI Developers and Business Leads to conduct business requirement gathering & continuous improvement sessions to support the business and understand requirements for analytical projects and develop necessary requirement documents and acceptance criteria to support their development in line with process guidelines    Develop UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and SIT (System Integration Testing) test cases based off analytical data product requirements.    Support for scoping, building, testing, and maintaining transport/data pipelines and retrieving applicable data sets for specific use cases.    Support building, testing, and maintaining data models with the flexibility to change when business requirements change, while also reconciling multiple logical source models into a single, logically consistent model.    Analyze the structure, format, and reliability of new and existing data sources, considering factors such as data integrity, completeness, accuracy, and drive continuous improvement.    Participate in data governance processes to ensure data is properly maintained and document for reusability by the business    Understand data and metadata to support consistency of information retrieval, combination, analysis, pattern recognition and interpretation.      What you will bring    A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:     Understanding of Data Engineering concepts within a business setting, including working with multiple systems such as SAP, internal and external data sources. Experience in developing, enhancing, testing, and maintaining data products.    Experience in using diverse range of languages and tools, including scripting languages, for data extraction, transformation, storage, processing, and integration.    Analyze business requirements as a guide for data modeling and apply data analysis, design, modeling, and quality assurance techniques, continuous improvement, based on a detailed understanding of business processes, to establish, modify or maintain data structures and associated components (entity descriptions, relationship descriptions, attribute definitions).    Ability to simplify complex problems and effectively communicating technical concepts to a diverse audience.      More about this role      What extra ingredients will you bring:      Cloud computing technologies (Azure, GCP)    Programming Languages: SQL, Python, PySpark (Apache Spark), DAX, etc.    Analytics platforms: Databricks, Google Cloud Dataproc, etc.    Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, and DataOps techniques.    Experience with ETL, Data pipelines and architecture    Technical Documentation    Experience in data modelling and wrangling techniques and tools i.e., Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Data vault, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, etc.    Data quality and profiling methods        Education / Certifications:      Bachelors degree in a related field. BS Computer Science, Information Systems, etc.      Job specific requirements:      1+ years Data Engineering/Modeling    3+ years Database Design      Work schedule:      Remote worker located in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Chicago, IL.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Spotlight Call: Thursday, September 24th a 1pm est  Experience: Junior Developer  Location: US Virtual (Remote)    Job Description  We are seeking a Junior Developer to join the development team for one of our product lines. The product has built a hosted diagnostic imaging and telemedicine platform, custom built with current web technologies and tools, deployed on AWS in an agile Scrum environment. It gives our customers access to and collaboration on diagnostic radiology. You will work across our full stack .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular alongside a closely-knit team of developers, designers, product managers, and QA testers. All candidates must have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, at least 3 years of relevant experience, and the ability to multitask in a deadline-oriented environment. The best fit will be a well-rounded individual with a desire to learn and grow, including learning to use AI tools like Claude to work more efficiently.    What will you do?  Design, code, test, debug, and document programs based on technical configurations developed by analysts and project teams. Estimate and track time required to complete work for project budgeting and financial tracking.  Develop program designs to meet technical configurations, ensuring resulting systems operate efficiently and reliably. Understand the business function supported by the application and ensure designs integrate with other related systems.  Code across our stack, using .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular as appropriate to the task.  Test and debug programs to finalize and ensure smooth operation.  Document program design, coding, and other details to guide others in application development, use, and maintenance.  Support, update, and maintain existing systems in response to business needs, system problems, or other factors. Coordinate with project teams to design, code, test, and document system changes.  Coordinate with project team members to define application requirements. Identify business needs, assess available technologies, and develop and present solutions.  Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up coding, testing, debugging, and documentation, and share efficiency practices with the team.  Provide a high level of customer service, partnering with end users in the resolution of problems or in deployment of new applications.  Participate as an active member of a cross-functional Agile Scrum team.    What do you need to succeed?  At least 3 years of relevant software development experience.  Familiarity with the application development process.  Experience with, or strong interest in learning, .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular.  Experience with HTML, JavaScript, and building web UIs.  Experience with, or willingness to learn, relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server) and Structured Query Language (SQL).  Comfort using AI tools such as Claude to write, review, test, or document code more efficiently.  Excellent problem-solving skills.  Excellent customer service and business relationship building skills.  Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, including the ability to translate technical subject matter to non-technical audiences. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Full Stack Developer. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Golang Backend Engineer   Location(s):  McLean, VA           As a Golang Backend Engineer, you'll be instrumental in designing and enhancing tools that contribute to efficiency, scalability, and streamlined operations within our organization. If you're a technically adept professional with a passion for driving seamless workflows, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.   Responsibilities:     Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and enhance internal tools, spanning tasks such as scheduling, provisioning, tunnel services, upgrades, and data management.   Create and manage services, both for internal and customer-facing use, ensuring secure and efficient data transmission.   Develop internal services to streamline configuration management, pipeline updates, and more.   Architect and implement systems for efficient asset movement across storage systems, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.   Maintain a versatile toolbox to enhance developer workflows and streamline processes.     Experience:     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).   Proven mastery of Golang and proficiency in Python or modern managed languages.   Familiarity with backing stores and databases including both SQL/NoSQL such as Postgres, Cassandra desirable   History of delivering products built on multiple frameworks such as Echo, Django, Flask   Demonstrated ability to not only code but also define, document, debug, and maintain Full stack applications   Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and network protocols.   An Agile mentality is required as we strive every sprint to design, code, test, and deliver solutions to our customers and in turn react and pivot based on their feedback   Excellent oral and written communication skills.   Should be equally capable of clarifying design points with architects and product owners as well as working with customer service to solve customer problems.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.
