skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Measurement Framework Developer – Data Scientist (Statistical & Causal Inference)   Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.       About the Role:     We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in statistical inference and causal analysis to develop measurement frameworks for enterprise solutions.    This role is ideal for someone passionate about designing experiments, applying causal inference methods, and building scalable frameworks to measure impact.         Key Responsibilities:     Design and implement measurement frameworks for solutions in production.   Apply statistical inference and causal methods (e.g., A/B testing, propensity score matching, instrumental variables).   Develop and analyze controlled experiments and observational studies.   Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and measurement strategies.   Write clean, reproducible code for statistical analysis and reporting.   Implement CI/CD principles and manage code repositories using GitHub Enterprise.     Required Qualifications:     Strong knowledge of hypothesis testing, OLS, GLM, and causal inference techniques.   Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with libraries like statsmodels, scikit-learn, DoWhy, linearmodels.   Experience with A/B testing and experimental design.   Familiarity with Databricks or similar enterprise cloud environments.   Self-starter with an ownership mindset and ability to work independently.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience in retail, inventory management, or operations research.   Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

About the Role:     We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in statistical inference and causal analysis to develop measurement frameworks for enterprise solutions.    This role is ideal for someone passionate about designing experiments, applying causal inference methods, and building scalable frameworks to measure impact.         Key Responsibilities:     Design and implement measurement frameworks for solutions in production.   Apply statistical inference and causal methods (e.g., A/B testing, propensity score matching, instrumental variables).   Develop and analyze controlled experiments and observational studies.   Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and measurement strategies.   Write clean, reproducible code for statistical analysis and reporting.   Implement CI/CD principles and manage code repositories using GitHub Enterprise.     Required Qualifications:     Strong knowledge of hypothesis testing, OLS, GLM, and causal inference techniques.   Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with libraries like statsmodels, scikit-learn, DoWhy, linearmodels.   Experience with A/B testing and experimental design.   Familiarity with Databricks or similar enterprise cloud environments.   Self-starter with an ownership mindset and ability to work independently.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience in retail, inventory management, or operations research.   Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Simulation Developer – Data Scientist (Simulation & Modeling)   Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.         About the Role:     We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist with expertise in simulation modeling, probability theory, and Python programming.         This role focuses on designing and deploying simulation frameworks to evaluate and optimize enterprise solutions. Ideal candidates will have experience in inventory models, stochastic processes, and building scalable simulation systems.         Key Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and deploy simulation models for inventory and operational systems using Python, SQL, and PySpark on platforms like Databricks.   Apply probability theory and Monte Carlo methods to model uncertainty and variability.   Collaborate with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to define simulation inputs and integrate pipelines.   Implement CI/CD principles and manage code repositories using GitHub Enterprise.   Validate and calibrate simulation models using historical data and sensitivity analysis.   Ensure code quality, scalability, and maintainability in production environments.     Required Qualifications:     Hands-on experience with simulation modeling and inventory systems.   Proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark.   Strong understanding of probability theory, stochastic modeling, and Monte Carlo simulation.   Experience with Databricks or similar enterprise cloud environments.   Familiarity with CI/CD principles and GitHub Enterprise.   Self-starter with an ownership mindset and ability to work independently.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience in retail, supply chain, or operations research.   Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).             Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

This role will develop, automate, validate, and maintain operational metrics and reporting across dispensing data sources while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, protected health information requirements, and covered-entity data-governance policies.   Core Responsibilities     Recreate, validate, maintain, and improve operational metrics using platform usage and pharmacy fulfillment data.   Improve the automation, accuracy, availability, and quality of dispensing and operational data.   Create and deploy operational dashboards for use within the covered entity.   Track and report performance metrics and provide timely, accurate updates to reporting tools.   Develop consolidated reporting views across dispensing data sources to support filtering, grouping, and finance reporting.   Conduct operational performance analysis using SQL and Excel.   Identify trends, operational issues, and improvement opportunities within pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment data.   Translate data findings into clear, actionable insights for internal stakeholders.   Support urgent operational issues through data-driven analysis and cross-functional problem-solving.   Contribute to KPI definitions, reporting standards, and data-strategy documentation.   Handle PHI and other sensitive data according to HIPAA, covered-entity policies, and established data-governance requirements.   Maintain appropriate separation between manufacturer and covered-entity data, including partner-level and patient-level information.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies     Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, healthcare administration, data science, or a related discipline.   Proficiency in SQL and Excel.   Proficiency in at least one statistical programming language: Python or R.   Familiarity with healthcare, pharmacy, claims, or dispensing operational data.   1–3 years of work experience within a HIPAA covered entity.   Experience developing, validating, or maintaining operational metrics and reporting.   Understanding of HIPAA, PHI handling, data privacy, and covered-entity compliance requirements.   Ability to complete and maintain required data privacy, HIPAA, and covered-entity compliance training.   Ability to handle protected health information according to established policies.     Preferred Skills or Experience     Experience creating operational dashboards, KPI reporting, or cross-source analytical views.   Experience improving reporting automation, data accuracy, or data-quality validation.   Understanding of pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment operations.   Experience documenting KPIs, reporting processes, or data strategies.   Understanding of manufacturer and covered-entity data-separation requirements.   Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and business acumen.   Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to internal stakeholders.   Experience working across business, operations, analytics, and compliance teams. skills.source: Position Details:   Title: Software Engineer   Duration: 12 months (Possible extension)   Location: San Antonio, TX  Pay Range: $60.00/hr. - $60.00/hr. on W2  Job ID: 26-17344     Analyzes, designs, develops, tests, and maintains Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Purview based on customer requirements, using development standards and software development lifecycle process. Daily tasks include identifying requirements for digital transformation; planning 3 rd  party integrations,planning and developing native   code; contributing to build vs. buy decisions; and coding, testing, documenting, error handling, and mitigating performance improvements in the development life cycle. Demonstrates technical expertise and programming skills for assigned code base, develops new coding skills as required; establishes repeatable guidelines and scalable standards; and leads cross-disciplinary team to deliver solutions that meet business, technical, and user requirements.      Tasks and Responsibilities     Evaluate a legacy Enterprise Content Management (ECM) system to determine the best migration path to MS Sharepoint.    Designs, develops, tests and maintains MS SharePoint solutions to meet business requirements for documentation storage and records management.   Strong knowledge of SharePoint architecture, design, and workflows.   Configure retention policies per business requirements.    Design and build records management workflows.    Provide software development work estimates and work scheduling in coordination with project management.   Plans work schedule, including assessing work prioritization.   Collaborates with leadership, product owners, architects, and business liaison to understand requirements   Maintains and enhances existing system design through strong understanding of architecture and test-driven development skills.   Expert knowledge of database development in MS SQL Server.   Expert understanding of DevOps best practices, Code Repository Branching/Merging, and system integrations.   Expert knowledge of code implementation, and upgrades of platform infrastructures.   Plans work schedule and estimates for project management and resource coordination.   Works closely with Infrastructure and Architect teams to develop and enhance cloud-based solutions.   Responsible for development and documentation standards.   Performs peer reviews to ensure compliance, as well as overview of project documentation.   Identifies team challenges and manages project expectations to coordinate across other project teams, as well as managing customer relationships.   Ability to professionally negotiate and challenge decisions, when necessary, to ensure project success.   Participate in Agile development methodology and ceremonies including negotiations with product managers and stakeholders     Minimum Qualifications     Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering from an accredited university OR Relevant technical programming experience   Subject Matter Expert experience in web-based IT solutions:   Demonstrates at least primary technical skill area listed here: Java and/or web programming, including JSP, Servlets, JDBC, web services, mobile, Angular, React, React Native, VueJS, JSON and HTML web development, Relational database design and application development (i.e., Oracle, DB2, etc.), including SQL queries, PL/SQL, Oracle APEX, DB2, etc.,   Hands-on developer application server experience, including Apache Tomcat, WebSphere Application Server or other (preferred)   Experience with one or more development methodologies (i.e., waterfall, Agile, Rational Unified Process – RUP, etc.)   Proficient in using Github, including branching and merging.   Experience managing source code conflict resolution and releases for an entire squad   Object-oriented programming experience   Ability to work well in a team environment.   Ability to manage project schedules and tasks, working closely with Scrum Master to coordinate resources and timelines.   Demonstrates critical thinking problem solving skills on semirouting basis for creative and innovative solutions.   Demonstrates decision making, communication skills to address customer issues as well as analyze and clarify a new project assignment.   Demonstrates technical writing skills.   Demonstrates customer service and situation appropriate, professional  customer communication.   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Independent time management, responsible for general guidelines and project artifats.   Expert in the design and implementations of APIs and modern technology architecture     Preferred Qualifications     Java Developer Certification(s)   Oracle or DB2 Certification(s)   Experience with Oracle AEM integrations   Experience with Oracle Visual Builder   Subject Matter Expert experience in web-based IT solutions   Ability to communicate in a collaborative DevOps environment with the team, managers, business units and stakeholders.   Ability to document project integrations and effectively communicate at all levels of the organizational hierarchy.   Leadership skills and ability to mentor peer developers.   User Interface (UI) development experience   Expert knowledge and experience in mobile responsible Web design methodologies   Subject Matter Expert experience in mobile responsive Web design   Advanced knowledge of OWASP and familiarity with web application vulnerabilities.   Experience with CI/CD pipeline configurations and management   Working knowledge of source control software (SVN or Git), build and deployment tools (Maven, Jenkins, Gradle)   Sharp troubleshooting skills and real-world systems deployment experience.     Regards,   Alisha Keshri   Associate Recruiter   Artech Information System LLC   360Mt. Kemble Ave., suite 2000   Morristown, NJ 07960   Email:  Alisha.Keshri@artech.com ,

skills.label: Java
skills.source: The Content Platform team is looking for a Software Development Engineer. who will act as first level support and development for all incoming production software application issues dealing with merchandising applications. Your solutions will impact our customers directly! Primary responsibilities include developing monitoring solutions, troubleshooting/debugging and implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, C/C++, JAVA), performing SQL queries, improving our systems that gather metrics on our features, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges. Responsibilities also include working alongside development on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems. Job Qualifications:The ideal candidate is interested in a career in software development and is looking to utilize and expand their coding skills and gain exposure to a wide variety of software applications. They must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, are able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. Preferred coding skills: Perl, C/C++ and/or Java. Other desired technical skills include Mason, Perl CGI, Oracle SQL, HTML, UNIX/LINUX. A Computer Science or equivalent technical degree and 2-5 years of relevant experience is required.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Job Title: AI Engineer   Job Location:   Mclean, VA   Job Summary:   We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer to support the rollout, integration, and operationalization of Claude Code across engineering teams. The role focuses on enabling Large Language Model (LLM)–based development workflows using AWS Bedrock, ensuring scalable deployment on Kubernetes, and providing ongoing technical support and optimization. This position plays a critical role in driving enterprise adoption of Generative AI tools while ensuring reliability, security, and developer productivity.     Key Responsibilities:     Support the rollout and adoption of Claude Code across engineering teams.   Design, integrate, and operate LLM-powered workflows using AWS Bedrock.   Develop backend services and automation using GoLang.   Deploy, manage, and scale GenAI services on Kubernetes.   Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting for GenAI-related issues.   Collaborate with DevOps, Platform, and Security teams to ensure compliant and efficient deployments.   Monitor performance, usage, and cost of LLM workloads; optimize where necessary.   Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and best practices.   Stay updated with advancements in GenAI, LLMs, and AWS AI services.           Required Skills & Qualifications:     Strong experience with AWS, including IAM, networking, and observability.   Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock and managed LLM services.   Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI use cases.   Proficiency in GoLang for backend development and tooling.   Strong experience with Kubernetes (deployment, scaling, troubleshooting).   Experience supporting or running GenAI/ML platforms in production.   Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native architectures.             Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I   Location(s):  Sunnyvale, CA       Job Description:  The Agentic AI and Applied Foundation Model team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to improve the reliability, maintainability, and testability of complex robotic systems. You will build tools and infrastructure that help engineers diagnose failures, automate operational workflows, reproduce software environments, and understand exactly which software, models, firmware, configurations, and assets were used in each robot test.   This role sits at the intersection of robotics, developer infrastructure, automation, and machine learning systems. You will work with hardware, firmware, simulation, and applied ML teams to turn fragmented operational knowledge and manual processes into dependable software systems.   The ideal candidate is comfortable working across system boundaries, investigating ambiguous failures, and delivering practical tools that make other engineers more effective.   Key Responsibilities:     Develop tools for diagnosing, maintaining, and upgrading robotic systems.   Convert operational knowledge—such as troubleshooting sessions, runbooks, logs, and incident history—into structured, searchable, and context-aware support systems.   Build automation for operational workflows, including issue triage, ownership resolution, notifications, approvals, remediation, and escalation.   Design systems that safely automate actions on production or lab infrastructure while maintaining appropriate human review and auditability.   Build and maintain a registry of robots, test runs, software artifacts, machine-learning models, firmware versions, calibration data, configurations, and simulation assets.   Establish traceability between test inputs and results so experiments can be reproduced, compared, and audited.   Identify configuration and asset drift across development, simulation, and physical systems.   Create automated verification and regression-testing workflows for robotics software and infrastructure changes.   Reproduce robot software stacks in development or lab environments to support debugging, migration, and system-level testing.   Assist with separating software workloads from robot hardware and validating changes across different compute environments.   Support the testing and performance evaluation of optimized machine-learning inference paths.   Improve system observability through logging, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic tooling.   Participate in design reviews, incident response, operational support, and continuous improvement of engineering processes.   Produce clear documentation and share technical knowledge across teams.     Basic Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.   Software development experience using Python and C++.   Knowledge of object-oriented programming.   Experience designing, implementing, testing, and operating production-quality software.   Experience with Linux systems, command-line tooling, networking fundamentals, and debugging distributed or multi-component systems.   Experience building automation, internal developer tools, backend services, or systems integrations.   Familiarity with APIs, structured data, databases, and event-driven or workflow-based systems.   Ability to investigate ambiguous technical problems and turn manual processes into maintainable software solutions.   Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across hardware and software disciplines.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop development.   Experience with CI/CD, test infrastructure, artifact management, configuration management, or experiment-tracking systems.   Familiarity with cloud storage and compute services, containers, and infrastructure-as-code.   Experience with machine-learning model deployment, inference runtimes, GPU acceleration, or performance benchmarking.   Familiarity with simulation environments, digital assets, calibration workflows, or robot fleet management.   Experience building retrieval, search, or AI-assisted knowledge systems using documentation, runbooks, logs, and other operational data.   Experience developing safe automation for production systems, including approval workflows, access controls, audit trails, and rollback mechanisms.   Understanding of software and data provenance, reproducibility, versioning, and dependency management.   Experience improving observability and responding to operational incidents.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Job Summary   The Actuarial Software Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining actuarial calculation software within modern, scalable .NET-based systems. This role blends actuarial logic, strong software engineering practices, and insurance product knowledge to build accurate, performant, and maintainable calculation engines and APIs used across sales and illustration platforms. The engineer will collaborate closely with actuarial, engineering, and product teams in India and the US to deliver high-quality, compliant insurance solutions. Key Responsibilities D esign and develop modules using C# and .NET. Translate actuarial specifications into robust, testable software components. Build and enhance APIs and calculation services for illustration and quoting platforms. Ensure accuracy and performance of actuarial calculations. Apply OOP principles and industry best practices. Write unit tests and support automated testing for calculation integrity. Debug and troubleshoot calculation and system issues. Collaborate with teams across actuarial, product, QA, and engineering. Produce documentation for technical and actuarial processes. Provide accurate estimates and take ownership of deliverables. Participate in Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement activities. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional software development experience. Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem. Experience with ASP.NET/.NET Core, Web APIs, and service-oriented architecture. Solid understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns. Experience with SQL databases (SQL Server preferred): query optimization, data modeling, performance. Ability to interpret and validate financial/actuarial calculations. Hands-on experience with Excel for validating calculation logic. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development. Experience using Git/Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar tools. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Ability to bridge actuarial logic and software engineering. High ownership and accountability for assigned work. Comfort working in distributed India–US teams. Strong attention to detail, especially around financial accuracy. Willingness to continuously learn insurance domain knowledge and modern practices. Pr eferred Qualifications (if any) Experience building or supporting insurance illustration or actuarial systems. Exposure to annuity, life insurance, or retirement products. Experience with Entity Framework or similar ORMs. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with performance optimization techniques (caching, async processing). Basic understanding of application security and data protection best practices. Certifications (if any) Not required, but certifications in .NET, cloud platforms, or actuarial systems are a plus. r

Required Skills & Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.   Proficiency in Python, and C and C++ for low-level software development and optimization.   Experience with machine learning frameworks optimized for edge deployment, such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime, or PyTorch Edge.   Familiarity with the Android platform stack, specifically regarding multimedia or camera subsystem integration.   Solid understanding of computer vision fundamentals, digital signal processing (DSP), or basic camera architectures.   Previous AI experience.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Hands-on experience developing within the Android camera framework to control, process, route, and transform real-time image streams.   Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, and hardware-specific compilation for NPUs, GPUs, or DSPs.   Background in developing low-latency algorithms for real-time edge applications (e.g., biometric verification, image restoration, or on-device language processing).     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design and deploy high-performance computer vision and machine learning pipelines directly onto resource-constrained edge hardware.   Optimize concurrent ML workloads to maximize throughput and minimize latency when running multiple edge-AI features simultaneously.   Integrate edge-AI algorithms seamlessly within the Android camera framework and multimedia subsystems.   Collaborate across software and hardware teams to bridge low-level camera sensor subsystems with on-device neural processing units (NPUs).   Profile and optimize memory footprint, power consumption, and execution timing to meet strict on-device performance constraints.     Company Benefits & Culture     Competitive salary and benefits package.   Opportunities for professional growth and development.   Collaborative and innovative work environment.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex. Share your resume at aditya.singh3@artech.com

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic Systems).   Location:  Chantilly, VA.         Job Description:     The AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic Systems) designs, prototypes, and builds generative AI and agentbased automations for knowledge work, decision support, and business workflows, and evaluates AI platforms and AI features embedded in 3rd party products.   This role experiments with and develops POCs/MVPs with large language models (LLMs), small language models (SLMs), retrievalaugmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI patterns.     Key Responsibilities:     GenAI POC and MVP Development     Design and implement GenAIpowered automations using LLMs/SLMs, tools, and agents.       Inference Pipelines for GenAI     Design and build GenAI inference pipelines that:   Accept structured and unstructured inputs.   Apply prompt templates and system instructions.   Invoke LLMs and tools.   Postprocess outputs into reliable, auditable results.   Support realtime, batch, and asynchronous inference patterns.       Prompt Engineering & Feature Engineering (Data)     Design and test prompt templates for data.   Implement data feature engineering for GenAI.       Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration     Design and prototype/develop agentic automations that decompose tasks, plan and reason oversteps, invoke tools and APIs, and handle errors and retries.   Integrate agents with AI platform and other source APIs.   Apply guardrails to control agent autonomy, cost, and risk.       Evaluation of SaaS / COTS GenAI Capabilities     Technically evaluate GenAI and agentic features embedded in thirdparty SaaS/COTS products, including:   LLM, SLM usage patterns and limitations.   Prompt and agent customization options.   API accessibility and automation readiness.   Observability and audit controls.   Provide technical input to architecture, procurement, and governance decisions.         Required Qualifications:     Technical Skills     Strong proficiency in Python and APIbased service development.   Handson experience with LLMs, SLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI frameworks or patterns.   Experience building inference pipelines for GenAI.   Strong understanding of APIfirst and eventdriven architectures.   Experience integrating AI services with enterprise systems and SaaS platforms.       Conceptual & System Skills     Deep understanding of GenAI inference vs traditional deterministic systems, promptcentric and contextcentric design, and agent autonomy vs control tradeoffs.   Ability to translate experimentation into reliable, automated AI systems.   Strong collaboration skills across engineering, product, data, and governance teams.         Preferred Qualifications:     Experience building and maintaining GenAI systems in enterprise or regulated environments.   Familiarity with:     Vector databases and document retrieval systems.   Cost and latency optimization for LLMs and SLMs.   Monitoring and evaluation of GenAI outputs.       Experience assessing vendorprovided GenAI platforms and features.   Exposure to AI risk management or responsible AI practices.               Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

With strong foundational skills in SQL, they will work with datasets from a variety of sources, write complex queries to join disparate data, and collaborate with the larger Enterprise Business Intelligence team to provide meaningful and actionable insights that solve business challenges across the organization. Strong analytical and detail-oriented thinking is required along with a solid understanding of relational databases.      A Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or other technically-intensive field;   Proficiency in constructing and interpreting complex SQL queries including joins, pivots, aggregation, basic case/if logic, common table expressions (CTEs), and window functions;   Understanding of and exposure to data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI;   Familiarity with data exploration and basic statistical analysis including hypothesis testing;   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, creativity in solving problems, strong attention to detail and accuracy, and the ability to perform with limited guidance;   Ability to communicate complex insights to teammates and non-technical stakeholders.     In addition, a preferred candidate will possess:     Experience in working with Snowflake databases;   Basic proficiency with manipulating data in R and/or Python;   Familiarity with basic machine learning concepts (i.e. multivariate regression) including how to perform and interpret them.     Skills:     SQL and any other Database Systems such as Snowflake, Writing Queries, Pivot, CTE, Analytical.   Proficiency in constructing and interpreting complex SQL queries including joins, pivots.     Education:     Bachelors in IT, Data Science or any relevant Technical fiel.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

Integrate AI services with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms.   Monitor model performance, accuracy, security, and governance while continuously improving AI solutions.     Company Benefits & Culture     Competitive salary and benefits package.   Opportunities for professional growth and development.   Inclusive and collaborative work environment.     For immediate consideration, please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end development of robust applications, bridging the gap between scalable Java back-end systems and highly responsive Angular and React front-ends.    In this role, you will navigate a complex, multi-application ecosystem, requiring a deep understanding of architectural dependencies and modern engineering practices. You will act as a catalyst for innovation by integrating AI-driven tools into the daily engineering workflow to enhance design, accelerate development, and streamline code reviews. We value engineers who are not only technically proficient but also passionate about knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.         Responsibilities    ·          Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve software across the entire stack.    ·          Manage and optimize database interactions across both SQL and MongoDB environments.    ·          Implement and maintain rigorous testing standards utilizing modern frameworks (e.g., Cucumber) to ensure high code quality and reliability.    ·          Leverage AI-assisted tooling to optimize the software development lifecycle, from initial architecture design to comprehensive peer reviews.    ·          Actively facilitate knowledge transfer across the engineering organization, ensuring team members are aligned on best practices and architectural decisions.    ·          Analyze complex system logs and large datasets to troubleshoot issues and optimize application performance.         Minimum qualifications:    ·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    ·          Experience in full-stack software development with a strong focus on Java.    ·          Hands-on experience developing user interfaces using modern front-end frameworks, specifically Angular and React.    ·          Experience designing and interacting with relational and NoSQL databases, including SQL and MongoDB.    ·          Experience with version control systems and collaborative development using GitHub.    ·          Practical experience utilizing AI tools to assist with software design, active development, and pull request (PR) reviews.         Preferred qualifications:    ·          Experience writing automated tests using frameworks such as Ruby and Java Cucumber.    ·          Familiarity with large-scale data analytics, logging, and monitoring tools (e.g., BigQuery, Splunk).    ·          Experience or familiarity with the .NET framework.    ·          Proven ability to navigate and engineer solutions within complex, multi-application environments and distributed systems.    ·          Exceptional knowledge transfer skills, with a track record of effectively mentoring peers and documenting complex technical domains.

A/B Testing and Experimentation Frameworks: Experience in designing, executing, and evaluating growth experiments.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with targeted marketing email initiatives.   Experience in constructing custom audience data tables derived from cross-app user behavioral metrics.   Experience executing end-to-end growth and promotional experimentation.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Develop and maintain deep links for paid campaigns, influencer attribution, referrals, and off-platform channels.   Implement and maintain conversion tracking mechanisms within user onboarding flows.   Support targeted marketing email initiatives by mapping user behavioral signals into defined audience parameters.     Company Benefits & Culture     Collaborative and innovative work environment.   Opportunities for professional development and growth.   Flexible work arrangements.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Job Title : Software Dev Engineer - Software Dev Engineer IV     Job Location:  Dallas, TX.   Job Description:   Design, develop, implement, test, document and deliver large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems and services using multi-threaded programming, distributed programming in Java, Python, Typescript, React, SQL, Object Oriented design and design patterns. Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements, and translate requirements into technical specifications for robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture. Own delivery of entire piece of system or application, and serve as technical lead on complex projects using best practice engineering standards. Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation. Participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation and travel for onsite troubleshooting or project launch.   Qualifications:     MS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus one year of experience in the job offered or related occupations of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related.   Experience in the job offered or related occupation must involve multi-threaded programming and distributed programming in Java, Python, Typescript, React.   Experience must also involve JDBC, SQL, and Object Oriented design and design patterns.   Requires experience using AI coding tools, and with MCP, building agents using any of the agent frameworks.   Requires availability for travel and 24x7 on-call support rotation.   Employer will accept Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus five years of progressively responsible experience in the specialty as equivalent to the Master's degree.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Introduction   Join our diverse global team to design and develop embedded software in areas related to cloud-based computing, ad-hoc computing, and embedded platforms. This role focuses on the Body Control Module, directly impacting vehicle safety, user experience, and electrification readiness.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Experience in the full lifecycle of embedded software development for safety-critical automotive systems.   Strong understanding of hardware-software interaction, real-time constraints, and communication protocols (CAN/LIN).   Proficient in MATLAB/Simulink (including Stateflow) for modeling, designing, and simulating embedded control algorithms.   Ability to write clean, efficient, and standards-compliant code for embedded automotive applications, including scripting for automation.   Proficiency in writing and debugging C/C++ code for real-time, resource-constrained embedded targets, including implementing AUTOSAR software components.   Prior work experience in the automotive industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Master's Degree in a relevant field.   Experience with DaVinci Developer for AUTOSAR configuration and integration.   Familiarity with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), ASPICE, and AUTOSAR standards.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design, develop, and implement embedded control systems for Body Control Modules (BCM).   Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to capture system-level requirements and translate them into detailed specifications.   Lead test strategy design and execution, including MIL, SIL, and HIL simulations, plus unit/integration testing.   Conduct root cause analysis of defects and implement robust fixes.   Identify development bottlenecks and implement Python-based automation scripts and reusable model templates. skills.source: Our client is currently seeking a Data Analyst II 			 The CX Insights and Engagement Team designs and implements a best-in-class Voice of the Customer (VOC) program to drive customer-centric decision-making. This role requires strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, financial/analytical, and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in leading data-driven customer experience programs and implementing enterprise technology solutions. They thrive in an environment that promotes customer-centricity, teamwork, and accountability. As part of a dynamic and growing team, you will generate insights and customer experience solutions that impact the entire Consumer CX Organization. What will you do: Design, build, and implement VOC data flow, data validation, and system integrations in collaboration with GTS, AI&D, vendors, business teams, and development teams. Drive agile project management, including creating user stories in Jira, leading grooming sessions, and ensuring successful sprint execution. Utilize expertise with VOC vendors such as Qualtrics, Medallia, and other customer experience platforms to design, analyze, and optimize VOC programs. Partner with cross-functional teams to implement technology solutions that enhance customer insights and improve overall experience. Ensure seamless integration of VOC systems with enterprise data architecture to support data-driven decision-making and actionable insights. Manage data ingestion processes, ensuring seamless integration across multiple systems. Lead system integrations, APIs, and real-time payload creation to optimize VOC programs. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant experience in data engineering, system integration, and VOC program implementation. Proficiency in SQL to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets. Hands-on experience with system integrations, data engineering, and data migration, with a solid understanding of data architecture across multiple systems. Ideally, You Will Also Have: A background in marketing, computer science, business transformation, data science, or customer experience in a business, agency, or consulting environment. Experience developing and automating data analytics and conducting ad-hoc analyses. Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to meet and exceed business objectives. A high level of accountability and ownership. The ability to build strong relationships with business partners, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver results on time.

evidence.text: Reduced reconciliation errors 90% by automating transaction matching, validation and exception reporting with SQL and Python.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and enhancing user interfaces for web applications using the Blazor framework, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of engaging and functional designs.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing previous work (web applications, mobile apps, etc.).   Experience with Blazor (knowledge of Blazor components, layout patterns, and integrations).   Strong proficiency in Figma for wireframing, UI design, and prototyping.   Familiarity with design tools such as Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar.   Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to better understand design constraints and collaboration with development teams.   Strong understanding of UI/UX best practices and principles.   Ability to create user-centric designs that meet both business goals and user needs.   Solid understanding of responsive design and mobile-first approaches.   Excellent communication and collaboration skills.   Detail-oriented with a passion for creating pixel-perfect designs.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with additional design tools and software.   Background in conducting user research and usability testing.   Experience contributing to design systems.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design and enhance user interfaces for web applications using the Blazor framework, ensuring consistency with branding and best design practices.   Create detailed wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design ideas effectively.   Conduct user research and usability testing to gather insights and iterate designs based on user feedback.   Work closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, developers, and QA engineers to translate product requirements into engaging and functional designs.   Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately in the Blazor framework, providing design assets and specifications.     Company Benefits & Culture     Comprehensive benefits package.   Supportive and collaborative work environment.   Opportunities for professional growth and development.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Job Title: Software Dev Engineer - Software Dev Engineer IV  Job Location: Dallas, TX    Job Description:    Design, develop, implement, test, document and deliver large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems and services using multi-threaded programming, distributed programming in Java and C, JDBC, SQL, Object Oriented design and design patterns, Oracle, and middleware messaging systems in a Linux environment. Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements, and translate requirements into technical specifications for robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture. Own delivery of entire piece of system or application, and serve as technical lead on complex projects using best practice engineering standards. Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation. Participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation and travel for onsite troubleshooting or project launch.     Qualifications - MS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus one year of experience in the job offered or related occupations of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related.   Experience in the job offered or related occupation must involve multi-threaded programming and distributed programming in Java or C on Linux.   Experience must also involve JDBC, SQL, and Object Oriented design and design patterns.   Requires availability for travel and 24x7 on-call support rotation.   Employer will accept Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus five years of progressively responsible experience in the specialty as equivalent to the Master's degree.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

Job Title: Software Dev Engineer - Software Dev Engineer IV  Job Location: Dallas, TX    Job Description:    Design, develop, implement, test, document and deliver large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems and services using multi-threaded programming, distributed programming in Java and C, JDBC, SQL, Object Oriented design and design patterns, Oracle, and middleware messaging systems in a Linux environment. Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements, and translate requirements into technical specifications for robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture. Own delivery of entire piece of system or application, and serve as technical lead on complex projects using best practice engineering standards. Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation. Participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation and travel for onsite troubleshooting or project launch.     Qualifications - MS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus one year of experience in the job offered or related occupations of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related.   Experience in the job offered or related occupation must involve multi-threaded programming and distributed programming in Java or C on Linux.   Experience must also involve JDBC, SQL, and Object Oriented design and design patterns.   Requires availability for travel and 24x7 on-call support rotation.   Employer will accept Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus five years of progressively responsible experience in the specialty as equivalent to the Master's degree.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Request ID: 105319-1  Title: Software Validation Engineer  Location: Onsite: Glendale, WI 53209 (100% onsite (5 day) a week only)  Duration: 12+ Months (with possible extension)  Pay Range: $40- $45 an hour on W2     Skills:  Embedded Software/Firmware Development   Experience Required:  8-10     Role Description:  We are looking for an experienced  HIL Validation Engineer  with strong expertise in  Automotive Embedded Systems , especially  Battery Management System (BMS) ECU development . The candidate should have hands-on experience in  Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation, AUTOSAR, ASPICE processes, ECU testing, and software qualification activities (SWE.4/SWE.5/SWE.6) .   Key Responsibilities     Perform  HIL setup, configuration, validation, and testing  for automotive ECUs.   Develop and execute test cases for automotive systems, focusing on:     Functional testing   Performance testing   Reliability testing       Lead software validation activities independently across ECU development lifecycle.   Drive:     Test planning   Test execution   Defect tracking   Test reporting       Collaborate with System Engineering teams for:     Requirements analysis   Requirements traceability   Validation activities       Support  ASPICE compliance activities  and associated work products.   Develop automation scripts and test tools for efficient validation processes.   Debug and troubleshoot ECU, communication, and hardware-related issues.       Required Technical Skills   HIL Validation & Testing     Hands-on experience in  Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setup and validation .   Experience with:     dSPACE HIL systems   Vector HIL environments   VT System   Vector tool chain       Strong understanding of HIL simulation and testing methodologies.     Automotive Communication Protocols     Good knowledge of:     CAN   LIN       Strong understanding of diagnostic protocols:     UDS (ISO 14229)         Vector Tools & Automation     Hands-on experience with:     CANoe   CANalyzer   CANape XCP       Experience in CAPL scripting for:     Test automation   Script development   Validation activities         ASPICE & Software Validation     Strong understanding and practical experience with:     Automotive SPICE (ASPICE)   SWE.4 – Software Unit Verification   SWE.5 – Software Integration and Integration Testing   SWE.6 – Software Qualification Testing       Experience supporting ASPICE audits and documentation.     ECU & Embedded Software Development     Experience in Automotive Embedded System development, preferably:     Battery Management System (BMS) ECU development       Knowledge of:     AUTOSAR architecture   AUTOSAR tool chains   ECU virtualization / Virtual ECU development       Experience with:     32-bit Microcontroller drivers   Application software development   Platform software development       Knowledge of embedded compilers and development environments.     Requirements & Configuration Management Tools     Experience working with:     JAMA   IBM DOORS   JIRA   GIT       Ability to manage requirements, traceability, and validation artifacts.       Test Engineering Skills     Develop comprehensive automotive test cases and test scenarios.   Experience in testing automotive systems, including:     Steering systems   Braking systems   Battery Management Systems       Good understanding of test processes and methodologies.   Knowledge of ISTQB Foundation Level is preferred.   Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and electronic laboratory skills.       Essential Experience     Strong experience in the  Automotive domain .   Hands-on experience in  HIL validation activities .   Experience with ECU development lifecycle.   Practical exposure to  SWE.4, SWE.5, and SWE.6 activities .   Experience with AUTOSAR-based embedded systems.   Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.       Preferred Skills     Experience with Vector CANoe automation frameworks.   Knowledge of XCP protocol and CANape usage.   Experience with ECU virtualization.   Experience in Battery Management System validation.   ISTQB certification preferred.       Soft Skills     Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.   Good communication and stakeholder management skills.   Ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.   Strong documentation and reporting skills.     Company Benefits & Culture   •    Inclusive and diverse work environment  •    Opportunities for professional growth and development  •    Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

skills.source: Job Description:   Job Title: Informatics Data Analyst       Location: 900 S. Fremont Ave., Alhambra, CA, 91803       Duration: 12-month contract       Pay Rate: $39/hr. on W2.  Job ID: 26-28488  Only USC and GC     Position Description:       An Informatics Data Analyst works independently to document external data acquisition policies and procedures as well as interface with other business units to define and document data needs and ad-hoc analysis requirements; identify business practice workflow and process issues and concerns; provide leadership and guidance to define system and process requirements that will optimize system performance and technology utilization by system users; and design information systems and technologies that ensure access and transparency. The Informatics Data Analyst will develop, implement, organize, and maintain information and reports to document operational and financial performance; collaborate with the quality team, administrators, etc., to design the ad hoc and other relevant routine reports; monitor the quality programs and make efforts to improve them; compile data from multiple sources and import the data into the relevant database; select appropriate tools and methods to maintain the existing programs that ensures there is appropriate transfer of data and that all the reports are documented well to increase the efficiency; assist with analysis of external data definitions documentation and mapping process; perform a Quality Assurance function for the data integration processes and repository metrics; collaborate with other staff to document data needs and metric definitions; validate data load processes and the quality of the data loaded into data repositories; maintain, store, map and analyze data in compliance with policies and procedures; coordinate with LAN and IT Security teams in order to utilize PGP encryption software and File Transfer Protocols; and use software such as SAS, Access, and Excel to provide data mapping for integration using Business Objects, and SQL.       Skills Required:        The Informatics Data Analyst will possess knowledge and experience in basic statistical concepts; identifying the trends, business opportunities, and relevant issues; commonly-used demographics and databases; definitions of fields and how data is entered and processed; data mining/intelligence; statistically-valid analysis and measurement methodologies; packaging data – infographics and other data display techniques, and report design options; data interpretation and validation; Ad Hoc analysis/performance evaluation principles; common demographic data bases; SQL coding and report services; data warehouse design; web-based application design; PC skills (e.g. Client Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SAS, Access and Excel); working independently as well as a leadership role in creating process documentation and interfacing with other team members to obtain this information; detailed-oriented; excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills; ability to handle multiple tasks; and problem solving and troubleshooting skills.       Additional Skills Required:        California Resident Candidates Only. Additional live scan requirements must be completed for the Department. Work is expected to be done ON SITE, and interviews will be conducted via MS Teams meetings. The work schedule will be 4/40, 10-hour day, Monday - Thursday." or "California Resident Candidates Only. Work is expected to be done ON SITE, and interviews will be conducted in person. Work schedule is M-Thurs 7:15am-6pm (10 hours) at Public Works HQ in Alhambra, CA 91803       Experience Required:        This classification must have a minimum of two (2) years of experience in processing, management, and retrieval of information.       Education Required:        This classification requires the possession of a bachelor’s degree in an IT-related or Engineering field. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis.     Regards,   Alisha Keshri   Associate Recruiter   Artech Information System LLC   360Mt. Kemble Ave., suite 2000   Morristown, NJ 07960   Email:  Alisha.Keshri@artech.com ,  Website:  www.artech.com

skills.source: Job Description  Spotlight call- Wednesday, 8/19/26 at 9:30am- please do not submit any candidates until after the call has taken place.       Location: Maine- virtual (EST hours- details will be discussed on call).   This team is responsible for testing the quality, reliability, and stability of IDEXX Applications and Systems. This includes both Cloud and on-prem applications. This group is generally more technical looking at more key projects, key initiatives, high profile services for IDEXX and making sure they are built with quality and performing. Automation testing is a functional software testing technique that ensures our products are of high quality and reliable.       In this role...    You will do roughly 85% automation and 15% manual testing    You will develop and execute formal Test plans, procedures and scenarios for automated testing to ensure quality of software applications. Reviews and assesses test coverage to ensure thorough quality review.    You will plan tests, writes test cases/scripts, develops & executes automated test cases.    You will perform various Test Types including smoke, application, functional and regression testing. Including appropriate level of testing to ensure that systems or applications are tested effectively prior to implementation.    You will document and track test results, defects, ROI and other quality metrics. Enters problems and issues into system and participates in analysis and resolution.    You will develop and implement quality standards and best practices, contributing ideas and effort toward continuous improvement.    Delivers quality process training to technical staff and acts as an internal quality consultant to advise or influence business or technical partners.       What you will need to succeed...    1-3+ years of QE Automation testing experience    Coding skills in Java are required for this    SQL skills are required    Cucumber experience is needed    Kotlin would be nice to have    Bachelors degree or equivalent combination of education and experience    Excellent problem-solving abilities.    Ability to multi-task, prioritize and meet deadlines.    Excellent verbal and written communication skills.    Drive and initiative.    Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with team members.    Excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

skills.source: Spotlight call- Wednesday, 8/19/26 at 9:30am- please do not submit any candidates until after the call has taken place.    Location: Maine- Preferred as the team meets in the Westbrook, ME office for 1-day "workshops" when the work requires it. NOT a hybrid role- only need to be in the office for "workshop" day.    The manager will also review candidates who are in the EST time zone.    This team is responsible for testing the quality, reliability, and stability of *** Applications and Systems. This includes both Cloud and on-prem applications. This group is generally more technical looking at more key projects, key initiatives, high profile services for *** and making sure they are built with quality and performing. Automation testing is a functional software testing technique that ensures our products are of high quality and reliable.  In this role...  You will do roughly 85% automation and 15% manual testing  You will develop and execute formal Test plans, procedures and scenarios for automated testing to ensure quality of software applications. Reviews and assesses test coverage to ensure thorough quality review.  You will plan tests, writes test cases/scripts, develops & executes automated test cases.  You will perform various Test Types including smoke, application, functional and regression testing. Including appropriate level of testing to ensure that systems or applications are tested effectively prior to implementation.  You will document and track test results, defects, ROI and other quality metrics. Enters problems and issues into system and participates in analysis and resolution.  You will develop and implement quality standards and best practices, contributing ideas and effort toward continuous improvement.  Delivers quality process training to technical staff and acts as an internal quality consultant to advise or influence business or technical partners.  What you will need to succeed...  1-3+ years of QE Automation testing experience  Coding skills in Java are required for this (understand how to work with Java)  SQL skills are required  Cucumber experience is needed  Kotlin would be nice to have  Bachelors degree or equivalent combination of education and experience  Excellent problem-solving abilities.  Ability to multi-task, prioritize and meet deadlines.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Drive and initiative.  Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with team members.  Excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills

skills.source: Our client is currently seeking a Data Analyst / Business Systems Analyst  			    Job Title: Data Analyst / Business Systems Analyst - Liquidity Regulatory Reporting    Location:  Westlake, TX (Backup: Omaha, NE)- Hybrid (on-site 4 days per week)    Duration: 12+ Months         About the job    The Liquidity Regulatory Reporting      team within Treasury manages and monitors key regulatory liquidity metrics      and ensures compliance with applicable requirements. This includes the      Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and related public disclosures, the Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR), and the FR 2052a Complex Institution Liquidity      Monitoring Report. The team also develops tools to help our business      partners analyze the impact of business decisions. In addition, we      collaborate with internal and external partners on ongoing examinations      and audits of liquidity practices. As a Regulatory Reporting Analyst,      you will support the daily production, validation, control, and submission      processes for U.S. liquidity regulatory reporting. You will take primary      responsibility for FR 2052a reporting while providing additional support      for the LCR and NSFR reporting processes. This role requires strong      analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently      manage daily production activities within strict regulatory deadlines      while partnering cross-functionally with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data,      and Technology teams.         Responsibilities    Execute daily FR 2052a production, validation, and      regulatory submission activities in accordance with established procedures      and strict reporting deadlines. Perform detailed variance analysis, reconciliations,      and quality reviews to ensure reporting completeness, accuracy, and      compliance. Utilize SQL to analyze large datasets, investigate      reporting anomalies, and identify root causes of data issues. Monitor reporting processes, data feeds, and system      interfaces; promptly identify, escalate, and track issues to ensure timely      and effective resolution. Support LCR and NSFR reporting processes, including      data validation, reconciliations, and reporting controls. Partner with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data Management,      and Technology teams to resolve data discrepancies and implement reporting      enhancements. Maintain and enhance reporting procedures, control      documentation, governance evidence, and audit support materials. Participate in testing, implementation, and production      validation of regulatory reporting changes, system upgrades, and new      initiatives. Identify and implement automation opportunities to      improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual processes, and strengthen      operational controls. Develop comprehensive business requirements for      functional and nonfunctional enhancements supporting liquidity regulatory      reporting processes. Create and optimize SQL queries to analyze datasets of      varying complexity, develop analytical models, and interpret data from      multiple sources (databases, spreadsheets, and reporting systems).         Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor's degree. 2-5 years of related experience within a financial      institution (e.g., banking or broker-dealer businesses). Experience with liquidity regulatory reporting,      specifically FR 2052a, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), and Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR). Experience working with SQL and Microsoft Excel to      analyze large datasets and run complex queries. Basic knowledge of finance and accounting principles.         Preferred Qualifications    Experience with AxiomSL ControllerView. Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting policy. Hands-on experience implementing automation tools to      optimize reporting processes. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a      proven track record in data analysis and trend identification. Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to      create comprehensive business requirements, process documentation, and      analytical reports. Ability to navigate ambiguity, make informed decisions,      and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.    Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

skills.source: Job Title:  Graphics Software Engineer   Work Location:  San Diego, CA 92121 (100% onsite)   Duration of Assignment:  3+ Months   Pay Rate Range:  $60.00-$68.00/hr on W2     Job Description:   Top 5 Required Skills (These are not preferred skills. If the candidate does not have these required skills, they will be rejected completely)     1. Vulkan Graphics Programming  - Strong experience with Vulkan render pipelines, compute shaders, synchronization, descriptor sets, memory barriers, and GPU-driven rendering.   2. Modern C++ Performance Engineering  - Expert-level C++ for real-time systems, memory management, multithreading, SIMD-friendly data layouts, and low-latency rendering code.   3. Mobile GPU Optimization  - Deep understanding of mobile GPU architectures, especially tile-based rendering, bandwidth limits, cache behavior, thermal constraints, and power/performance tradeoffs.   4. GPU Compute and Shader Optimization  - Ability to optimize GLSL/SPIR-V compute and graphics shaders, including sorting, culling, binning, blending, prefix sums, compaction, and parallel data processing.   5. Graphics Performance Profiling and Debugging  - Experience identifying GPU bottlenecks using profiling tools, analyzing frame timing, shader occupancy, memory bandwidth, overdraw, synchronization stalls, and CPU/GPU overlap.     Required Technologies  - Vulkan  - C++17/C++20  - Android NDK  - GLSL or HLSL  - SPIR-V  - Qualcomm Adreno GPU architecture  - Snapdragon mobile platforms  - Qualcomm Snapdragon Profiler  - RenderDoc  - Android Studio / Android build tools  - CMake  - GPU compute shader math  - Real-time rendering pipelines     Required Education:   Required Years of Experience  Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Game Rendering, or related work experience.     Principal Duties and Responsibilities:  • Applies Graphics knowledge and experience to architect, design, implement, and verify the structure and performance of GPU hardware, drivers, features, applications, and tools.  • Writes code for features, drivers, and APIs using different languages (e.g., C, C++, perl, python) and ensures code will perform effectively on different platforms.  • Maintains comprehensive pre- and post-silicon tests using tools and methods in different environments (e.g., simulation, emulation, on-device) to verify performance and identify issues.  • Identifies deficiencies in designs and works with team members to develop solutions to improve designs.  • Collaborates with teams and external stakeholders to expose new features and functionality that align with needs and goals for implementation and customization.  • Writes detailed design documentation and feature descriptions for projects to guide developers and/or customers to use or implement software.     Job Overview   We are seeking a contractor Graphics Software Engineer to support development of real-time Gaussian Splatting–based rendering systems for avatar and XR applications running on-device (edge devices such as Android phones and AR glasses).  This role focuses on GPU optimization, memory-efficient data pipelines, and real-time Gaussian Splatting rendering under mobile constraints. The ideal candidate will be highly hands-on and able to quickly improve performance-critical systems deployed directly on hardware.   Key Responsibilities   1. Gaussian Splatting Rendering    Develop and optimize Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering pipelines       Improve performance of splat-based rendering, including sorting, data layout, and shader efficiency       Analyze and resolve issues such as:       Splat flickering and popping       Sorting inconsistencies       Precision differences between CPU and GPU    2. On-Device GPU Optimization (Android / Edge Devices)    Optimize Gaussian Splatting pipelines for mobile GPUs (e.g., Adreno) on Android       Ensure efficient execution under limited memory, bandwidth, and power constraints       Tune rendering for real-time performance on phones and AR glasses    3. Data Pipeline & Memory Efficiency    Design compact data representations for Gaussian Splatting frame data       Optimize CPU → GPU data transfers for real-time rendering       Eliminate intermediate processing and reduce runtime memory overhead    4. Shader Development & Rendering Pipeline Integration    Implement GPU shaders tailored to Gaussian Splatting data formats       Optimize shader input pathways for efficient on-device execution       Integrate rendering pipelines with motion, lighting systems.    5. Debugging & System Validation    Debug complex rendering issues in Gaussian Splatting pipelines       Investigate numerical precision issues and GPU/CPU inconsistencies       Validate rendering output against reference pipelines    6. Collaboration & Execution    Collaborate closely with XR, vision, and avatar teams       Contribute to on-device demos and prototype systems (phones / AR glasses)       Execute quickly on well-defined tasks with strong ownership of implementation      Required Qualifications      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field       Strong programming skills in C/C++       Experience with Android platform development       Experience with GPU programming (OpenGL ES, Vulkan, or similar)       Solid understanding of:       Real-time rendering pipelines       GPU memory management       Performance optimization on embedded systems      Preferred Qualifications      Direct experience with Gaussian Splatting / Relighting / Simulation       Experience building graphics systems on mobile or XR devices       Familiarity with Adreno GPU architecture       Experience optimizing for real-time constraints (latency, bandwidth, power)       Experience debugging rendering artifacts in GPU pipelines
