skills.source: Job Title: Software Test Technician  Job ID: 37671966  Location: Minnetonka, MN 55305   (Hybrid)  Duration:12 months  Pay Rate: $45.00 - $50.00/hr. on W2     Job Description:  The responsibilities of this role are focused on developing and executing software tests in support of Monteris Medical’s software and integrated system releases. The Test Technician develops, executes, and maintains manual and automated test scripts and test cases to verify software against approved requirements and design specifications, working under the direction of the Manager, Software Engineering and V&V. This role applies hands-on application development and test automation skills- including C#, WPF, C++, and industry-standard automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, and JUnit - to support thorough, well-documented, and traceable testing of medical device software.     Primary Organization Responsibilities  Follows all applicable Monteris Quality System Standard Operating Procedures as well as various applicable FDA, ISO, CSA, and EU regulations and Guidance Documents. Will handle all matters using a high level of judgment, responsibility, and professionalism.  Develops, executes, and maintains automated test scripts and test tools using C#, WPF, and C++ to support software development and verification activities.  Executes manual and automated test protocols and test cases in accordance with approved test plans, requirements, and design specifications.  Builds and maintains automated test cases and test suites using NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or other equivalent automated test frameworks.  Sets up, configures, and maintains test environments, hardware/software test benches, and laboratory equipment required for verification testing.  Records, documents, and reports test results, defects, and anomalies with clear, accurate, and traceable documentation.  Supports defect identification, logging, tracking, and retesting through resolution and closure.  Assists in the development and revision of test cases, test scripts, and test procedures in response to requirement and design changes.  Maintains traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results within Jama.  Supports automated test execution, monitoring, and reporting through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.  Collaborates with software engineers, verification analysts, and quality personnel to ensure thorough and accurate test coverage.  Participates in the review of test protocols, test scripts, and test reports.  Supports troubleshooting and root-cause investigation of software defects identified during testing.  Supports testing of image processing and visualization features, including DICOM-based imaging workflows, as applicable to assigned projects.  Participates in the risk planning process as requested or required.  Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions by ensuring test documentation is complete, accurate, and audit ready.  Performs other duties as requested or assigned.     Skills:  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation skills.  Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), software test methodologies, and software quality assurance principles.  Ability to read and interpret software requirements, design specifications, and test protocols.  Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accurate, thorough, and traceable documentation.  Good organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple test activities and deadlines.  Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and report defects and results.  Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers, verification and validation staff, and quality personnel.  Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated development environment.  Willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, and imaging technologies as needed.  Ability to retain information on a confidential basis.     Education/Experience  Associate’s degree or technical certification in software engineering, computer science, engineering technology, or a related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.  Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software development and/or software testing.  Application development experience with C# and WPF.  Experience with C++ software development and/or test automation.  Hands-on experience with automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or comparable frameworks.  Experience executing software verification and validation activities, preferably within a regulated environment.  Experience with VTK/ITK and DICOM image processing and visualization is considered an asset.  Experience with requirements management tools such as Jama and automation orchestration tools such as Jenkins is considered an asset.

This role applies hands-on application development and test automation skills- including C#, WPF, C++, and industry-standard automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, and JUnit - to support thorough, well-documented, and traceable testing of medical device software.     Primary Organization Responsibilities  Follows all applicable Monteris Quality System Standard Operating Procedures as well as various applicable FDA, ISO, CSA, and EU regulations and Guidance Documents. Will handle all matters using a high level of judgment, responsibility, and professionalism.  Develops, executes, and maintains automated test scripts and test tools using C#, WPF, and C++ to support software development and verification activities.  Executes manual and automated test protocols and test cases in accordance with approved test plans, requirements, and design specifications.  Builds and maintains automated test cases and test suites using NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or other equivalent automated test frameworks.  Sets up, configures, and maintains test environments, hardware/software test benches, and laboratory equipment required for verification testing.  Records, documents, and reports test results, defects, and anomalies with clear, accurate, and traceable documentation.  Supports defect identification, logging, tracking, and retesting through resolution and closure.  Assists in the development and revision of test cases, test scripts, and test procedures in response to requirement and design changes.  Maintains traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results within Jama.  Supports automated test execution, monitoring, and reporting through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.  Collaborates with software engineers, verification analysts, and quality personnel to ensure thorough and accurate test coverage.  Participates in the review of test protocols, test scripts, and test reports.  Supports troubleshooting and root-cause investigation of software defects identified during testing.  Supports testing of image processing and visualization features, including DICOM-based imaging workflows, as applicable to assigned projects.  Participates in the risk planning process as requested or required.  Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions by ensuring test documentation is complete, accurate, and audit ready.  Performs other duties as requested or assigned.     Skills:  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation skills.  Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), software test methodologies, and software quality assurance principles.  Ability to read and interpret software requirements, design specifications, and test protocols.  Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accurate, thorough, and traceable documentation.  Good organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple test activities and deadlines.  Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and report defects and results.  Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers, verification and validation staff, and quality personnel.  Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated development environment.  Willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, and imaging technologies as needed.  Ability to retain information on a confidential basis.     Education/Experience  Associate’s degree or technical certification in software engineering, computer science, engineering technology, or a related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.  Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software development and/or software testing.  Application development experience with C# and WPF.  Experience with C++ software development and/or test automation.  Hands-on experience with automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or comparable frameworks.  Experience executing software verification and validation activities, preferably within a regulated environment.  Experience with VTK/ITK and DICOM image processing and visualization is considered an asset.  Experience with requirements management tools such as Jama and automation orchestration tools such as Jenkins is considered an asset.

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Data Analyst 3   Location(s):  Richmond, VA   (Hybrid: 2–3 days onsite per week)       Job Summary  We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Data Analyst to support IT FinOps initiatives. This role is pivotal in analyzing, modeling, and forecasting financial data related to Azure cloud services and on-premises data center workloads. The ideal candidate combines financial acumen with strong data analytics skills to support strategic decision-making and cost optimization initiatives.   Responsibilities     Analyze and interpret IT financial data across Azure and VITA environments, including consumption, billing, and chargeback models.   Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports to visualize cost trends, server migration impacts, and workload optimization opportunities.   Perform variance analysis on monthly and annual IT spend, identifying anomalies and opportunities for savings.   Manually maintain and enhance datasets from Apptio, Azure Portal, and SharePoint sources to ensure accuracy and completeness.   Document processes and procedures for financial reporting and analysis.   Collaborate with the technical cloud team, I&O team, and finance stakeholders to align cost models with operational realities.   Support Azure migration planning by modeling server cost scenarios and forecasting reserve capacity needs.   Contribute to FinOps strategy development by providing insights on cost drivers and utilization patterns.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field.   Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including Power Query and DAX, Excel (advanced), and data visualization best practices.   Data modeling and data manipulation skills to maintain datasets from multiple, heterogeneous sources.   High familiarity with Azure cost management, Apptio, and cloud billing structures.   Understanding of server migration strategies and workload cost modeling.   Ability to translate technical data into insights for technical teams and managers.     Preferred Qualifications     FinOps certification or training.   Experience with Azure Reserved Instances and Just-In-Time (JIT) capacity planning.   Knowledge of enterprise architecture and strategic IT planning frameworks. Required   4   Years                 Advanced level of proficiency in Power BI, including Power Query and DAX, Excel (advanced), and data visualization best practices. Required   5   Years                 Understanding of server migration strategies and workload cost modeling.   Required   5   Years                 Ability to translate technical data into insights for technical teams and managers   Required   5   Years                 Ability to work independently and apply critical thinking to analyze complex financial data and develop actionable recommendations.   Required   4   Years                 Proficiency in Power BI, including independently updating data, performing queries, and managing and analyzing datasets with little to no assistance.   Required   6   Years                 Ability to translate complex data into clear, accurate, and actionable information for leadership and decision-making. Creating databases of legacy information and establishing links to Tableau/PowerBI to create custom dashboards.   Provide the team with advanced analytics by defining and refining slicers, filters, and Legends across Dashboard reports.     Skills     Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.   Extensive experience in the Microsoft Power Platform – MS PowerApps, Excel, Access and specifically, visualization software PowerBI.   General understanding of building SQL Databases.   Keen understanding of PowerApps formulas and development methods.   Understanding of how to implement solutions with multiple data sources.     Education & Certifications   4 years.      Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. skills.label: Observability
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Software Engineer 2   Location:  Austin, TX.         Description of Services:    Client requires the services of 1 Software Engineer 2, hereafter referred to as Candidate(s), who meets the general qualifications of Software Engineer 2, Applications/Software Development and the specifications outlined in this document for the Client.    All work products resulting from the project shall be considered "works made for hire" and are the property of the Client and may include pre-selection requirements that potential Vendors (and their Candidates) submit to and satisfy criminal background checks as authorized by Texas law.     Work involves highly advanced (senior-level) systems administration in support of agency mainframe applications and supporting infrastructure; and coordinate day-to-day system administration functions such as mainframe configuration, break/fix system support, and base user account creation/support.   Routine system administration functions to include security administration support, performance monitoring, security monitoring, and system maintenance.   Work includes supporting data entry and control work processes, overseeing and coordinating mainframe operations in the State’s Consolidated Data Center Services (DCS), and working with the Network Administration, Customer Support and Applications Development & Support teams to provide support necessary for day-to-day mainframe operations.   Experience with Informatica Power Exchange Administration for Change Data Capture processing using mainframe data sources and targets (i.e., IMS and VSAM) a plus.     The Worker will apply their expert knowledge and experience as a Mainframe z/OS Systems Programmer to support both the needs of the Legacy Systems as well as those for the Mainframe Transformation Team.     Worker Skills and Qualifications:     Provide primary support as the subject matter expert for z/OS operating systems and system components; provide direct technical support as needed in the planning, implementation and testing of releases, upgrades, or changes to z/OS operating system, network, and component software.   Provide end user support for assigned Independent Software Vendor (ISV) products such as Blue Zone.   Provide primary administration and end user support for SCLM.   Provide input and recommendations for hardware capacity planning.   Provide primary administrative support for CICS® and IMS™.   Diagnose platform, software, and related product issues and follow up with root cause analysis.   Analyze performance issues and provide input and recommendations for capacity planning.   Provide input and recommendations for system-wide performance tuning to meet required levels of service.   Provide input and recommendations for system parameters and system libraries management.   Provide support for technical consultation and inquiries from the other IT technical teams.   Provide support as technical lead on internal team projects or participate on project teams that impact the z/OS platform.   Provide support for Integration-testing new products with existing applications and user procedures.   Assist with maintaining and providing technical support for Mainframe Production Control and Support Jobs and monthly Mainframe Job Scheduler.     II. CANDIDATE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS   Minimum Requirements:     5 Years Required: Experience with z/OS Systems Programming.   5 Years Required: Experience with JES2, z/OS Unix System Services (OMVS), Storage Management Subsystem (SMS).   3 Years Required: Experience with TSS (Top Secret Security).   3 Years Required: Experience with performance monitoring to include initial analysis of performance issues.   2 Years Required: Experience with REXX.   3 Years Preferred: Experience with Informatica Power Exchange Administration.   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: z/OS Operation, z/OS Networking – VTAM (Virtual Telecommunications Access Method), TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: z/OS-centric automated job scheduling and management software (JOBTRAC), Terminal Emulator Software (BLUEZONE), VTAM Session Manager Software (VTAM/SWITCH).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: SMP/E (System Modification Program/Extended), RMF (Resource Measurement Facility), SMF (System Management Facility), WLM (Workload Management), JCL (Job Control Language).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: GRS (Global Resource Serialization), VSAM (Virtual Storage Access Method), TSO (Time Sharing Option).   3 Years Preferred: Experience with TLS configuration (certificates, SSL – RSA Keys, SFTP, FTPS).   3 Years Preferred: Experience with SCLM (or other similar configuration management .tools), specifically configuration and administration of SCLM.   3 Years Preferred: Experience with CPM for JOBTRAC.           Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans, or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Job Description:	 Ansible Playbooks & Roles: Writing idempotent playbooks, structuring roles for reusability, managing dependencies. YAML & Jinja2: Deep understanding of YAML syntax, Jinja2 templating, filters, and conditionals for dynamic configuration. Inventory Management: Building dynamic and static inventories, grouping, host variables, and integration with external sources Linux Administration: Strong proficiency with common distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine), package management, systemd, networking config, and security hardening. Windows Support: Ansible Windows modules, PowerShell remediation, and Active Directory integration (if applicable). Infrastructure Abstraction: Combining Ansible with Terraform or CloudFormation for hybrid approaches or using Ansible alone for configuration post-provisioning. Container & Kubernetes: Ansible for cluster bootstrapping, pod/ deployment management, and container runtime configuration. Version Control: Git workflows for playbook/role repositories, branching strategies, and pull-request-based reviews. CI/CD Integration: Embedding Ansible runs in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure Pipelines for automated testing, linting (ansible-lint), and deployment. Testing & Validation: Using Molecule for role testing, TestInfra for server validation, and integration with schema/ policy checks. Secrets Management: Integrating with HashiCorp Vault, Ansible Vault, or cloud KMS for secure handling of passwords, API keys, and TLS certificates. Compliance & Auditing: Ensuring playbooks meet organizational security standards, generating compliance reports, and maintaining audit trails. Networking Basics: DNS, DHCP, VPCs/subnets, load balancers, firewalls, and IP address management. Other IaC Tools: Familiarity with Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation helps when designing hybrid or multi-cloud strategies. Observability: Wiring Ansible outputs into monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) for drift detection and operational visibility. Scripting & Automation: Python or Bash for custom modules, hooks, or glue code between Ansible and other tooling.  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.source: job summary:   Hiring for a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. Feature ownership:  Take end-to-end ownership of specific features and components, from understanding the problem through delivery, rollout, and long-term operation. Quality delivery:  Write maintainable, well-tested code while ensuring predictable delivery and effective observability. Team contribution:  Participate actively in code reviews, share technical knowledge, and collaborate closely with your peers to reduce knowledge silos. Product alignment:  Apply a strong product mindset to connect your daily engineering tasks to customer outcomes, payout speed, and system quality.         qualifications:   Requirements  Core stack: Solid experience building backend systems with Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot, microservices, relational databases, and well-designed APIs.  System knowledge: A working understanding of distributed systems principles, including asynchronous processing, data consistency, and failure recovery.  Working style: A self-starting and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently on defined features and ask the right questions when blocked.  Communication: Clear communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical concepts effectively with team members and cross-functional partners. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Dev10 is seeking a Full Stack Data Engineering Instructor for a Remote position. This is an 8+ month contract-to-hire opportunity.   This position is ideal for an experienced data professional who enjoys teaching, mentoring, and helping others launch successful careers in technology. The successful candidate will guide Associates through an intensive data engineering training program focused on data pipelines, cloud data platforms, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, big data technologies, data modeling, and modern data engineering practices. In addition to delivering instruction and providing technical coaching, the Instructor will collaborate with fellow instructors to continuously improve curriculum and ensure Associates are prepared to meet the evolving needs of enterprise clients in a data-driven world.   Responsibilities:     Participate in training activities daily during core hours of 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM CT   Deliver technical instruction, demonstrations, hands-on workshops, and Q&A sessions focused on data engineering concepts and technologies   Create an engaging and supportive learning environment that promotes student success   Monitor Associate progress and provide coaching to help learners achieve technical and professional development objectives   Support and troubleshoot student challenges during labs, exercises, and project work   Foster confidence, accountability, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills among Associates   Conduct weekly reviews of data engineering projects, pipelines, and code, providing detailed and constructive feedback   Evaluate technical assignments against industry standards, best practices, and client expectations   Meet one-on-one with Associates who need additional support or guidance   Collaborate with the instructional team to continuously improve curriculum, labs, and training materials   Support technical evaluations and assessments used during the recruiting process   Mentor new instructors as they develop classroom management and instructional skills   Stay current on emerging data engineering technologies, cloud platforms, and industry trends     Requirements:     3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics Engineering, Software Engineering with a strong data focus, or related disciplines   Strong understanding of data engineering principles, architectures, and best practices   Passion for mentoring, coaching, and developing technical talent   Excellent verbal and written communication skills   Ability to explain technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of experience   Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills   Python   SQL and Relational Databases   Data Modeling and Database Design   ETL/ELT Development   Data Warehousing Concepts   Data Integration and Data Movement Techniques   Apache Spark or Distributed Data Processing Frameworks   Cloud Data Platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)   Data Pipeline Development and Orchestration   Git and Version Control   Command Line/Terminal Fundamentals   Data Quality, Validation, and Testing Practices   Data Governance, Security, and Privacy Fundamentals   Software Development and Data Engineering Best Practices     Desired skills:     Previous experience as a technical instructor, trainer, educator, teaching assistant, or mentor   Experience leading technical workshops, bootcamps, or training programs   Experience reviewing code and data engineering projects   Experience building and maintaining enterprise data pipelines   Experience coaching junior data professionals or early-career technology talent   Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, or similar modern data platforms   Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data engineering solutions   Exposure to machine learning workflows, MLOps, or AI/Generative AI technologies   Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis   Curriculum development or instructional design experience     Preferred Technical Stack:     Python   SQL   Databricks   Apache Spark   Azure Data Factory   Azure Synapse Analytics   Snowflake   Delta Lake   Power BI   Azure Storage Services   Git/GitHub   CI/CD Pipelines   Data Modeling Tools and Techniques     Pay range: $55.00 - $75.00 per hour   Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.   If you have the described qualifications and are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply!   Benefits of Working with Genesis10:     Medical, Dental, Vision   Health Savings Account   Voluntary Hospital Indemnity (Critical Illness & Accident)   Voluntary Term Life Insurance   401K   Sick Pay (for applicable states/municipalities)   Commuter Benefits (Dallas, NYC, SF, and Illinois)   Fun & flexible team environment         Genesis10 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

skills.label: HTML
skills.source: Job Summary The Full Stack .NET Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core while supporting modern frontend technologies, REST APIs, SQL databases, and Microsoft Azure integration services. The role requires experience integrating applications with enterprise systems and cloud services, participating in CI/CD activities, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting application deployments across development, QA, and production environments. Practical exposure to several Azure integration services is sufficient, with a willingness to work across the broader Azure ecosystem. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core. •    Develop responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular, React, or similar JavaScript frameworks. •    Build reusable, maintainable, and secure application components. •    Participate in application architecture, design discussions, and technical solution development. •    Perform code reviews and follow established coding and development standards. •    Troubleshoot application issues and perform root-cause analysis. •    Design and develop RESTful APIs and web services. •    Integrate applications with internal and external enterprise systems. •    Work with JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, and API-based integration patterns. •    Implement synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns. •    Troubleshoot API and integration failures using application logs and monitoring tools. •    Develop and support cloud-based integrations using Microsoft Azure. •    Configure and support integrations between applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. •    Monitor Azure-based applications and integrations and troubleshoot production issues. •    Work with development and infrastructure teams to deploy and maintain applications in Azure. •    Design and develop database queries, stored procedures, and data-access components. •    Participate in CI/CD activities using Azure DevOps or similar tools. •    Work with Git-based source control and branching strategies. •    Support application deployments across development, QA, and production environments. •    Troubleshoot deployment and environment-related issues. •    Develop unit and integration tests for application components and APIs. •    Participate in SIT/UAT and defect resolution. •    Analyze application logs and production issues to identify root causes. •    Support application releases and production deployments. •    Implement performance, security, and reliability improvements. Required Qualifications •    Strong experience with C# and .NET/.NET Core. •    Experience developing REST APIs and web services. •    Experience with Entity Framework/EF Core, LINQ, Dependency Injection, Object-Oriented Programming, and Design Patterns. •    Experience with Angular or React. •    Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. •    Experience with responsive web development. •    Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Cosmos DB. •    Experience developing stored procedures and optimizing database queries. •    Understanding of relational database concepts. •    Hands-on or working knowledge of Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Storage, Azure Event Grid, and Azure Application Insights. •    Experience with REST/API integration, JSON/XML, authentication, and authorization. •    Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD concepts, and build and release pipelines. •    Experience participating in application deployments and production support. •    Experience developing unit and integration tests. •    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. •    Good communication and collaboration skills. •    Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. •    Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams. •    Strong ownership of application development, troubleshooting, and delivery. •    Willingness to learn and expand knowledge of Azure cloud and integration technologies.

skills.label: API
skills.source: Role: Full Stack Engineer Level II  Location: Riverwoods, IL/Remote (Must align with Central Time business hours)  Contract: 6 Months    Position Overview  Capital One's Legacy Discover API Management team is seeking an experienced Drupal / Acquia Cloud Developer to support the development, maintenance, and modernization of its external developer portal, hosted on Acquia Cloud and built on Drupal.  The primary focus of this role is supporting the migration of the existing portal from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11, maintaining custom Drupal modules, addressing vulnerabilities, applying patches, and resolving application issues. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with both Drupal development and the Acquia Cloud platform, along with strong backend development capabilities.    Key Responsibilities  •    Support the migration and upgrade of the external developer portal from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11.  •    Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Drupal-based applications hosted on Acquia Cloud.  •    Manage and enhance custom Drupal modules and contributed modules.  •    Support backend development, including customizations and PHP-based Drupal coding as required.  •    Perform vulnerability remediation, security patching, bug fixes, and routine application maintenance.  •    Participate in Agile sprint planning, feature development, and maintenance activities.  •    Troubleshoot migration issues and help ensure the portal remains stable and available throughout the upgrade.  •    Support planned application updates and maintenance activities outside regular business hours when required.  •    Collaborate with existing engineers, participate in knowledge sharing, and contribute to technical documentation.  •    Follow established change management and deployment procedures to minimize disruption to business operations.    Required Qualifications  •    Hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using Drupal.  •    Practical experience working with the Acquia Cloud platform.  •    Recent experience with modern Drupal versions, preferably Drupal 10 or Drupal 11.  •    Direct experience upgrading or migrating Drupal applications, particularly from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11.  •    Strong backend development skills and experience working with Drupal customizations.  •    Experience troubleshooting application issues, applying patches, and maintaining production websites.  •    Experience with vulnerability remediation, security patching, and application maintenance.  •    Ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed engineering team.  •    Availability to work during the team's core Central Time business hours.  •    Flexibility to support occasional planned off-hours maintenance.    Preferred Qualifications  •    Experience with PHP and custom Drupal module development.  •    Familiarity with Drupal contributed modules and customized Drupal environments.  •    Experience with Agile development practices, sprint-based delivery, and technical documentation.  •    Acquia Cloud certifications are a plus but are not mandatory.    Project Details and Working Expectations  •    Primary initiative: Support the Drupal 10-to-Drupal 11 migration, with a target deadline in December.  •    Application environment: The portal includes approximately 20 custom Drupal modules and 40 contributed modules.  •    Work arrangement: Fully remote; candidates may be located anywhere in the U.S. and do not need to report to the Riverwoods, Illinois office.  •    Working hours: Must align with the team's Central Time business hours.  •    Off-hours maintenance: Occasional maintenance may be required, typically within a late-evening or overnight window, approximately 9:00 PM to 2:00–3:00 AM, depending on the change. The team anticipates fewer than five such events over the six-month contract, potentially fewer. Weekend work may be avoidable.  •    Schedule flexibility: When off-hours maintenance is required, the engineer may coordinate adjusted working hours during the week. Overtime is not expected.  •    Contract term: Six months, with no guarantee of extension.

evidence.text: Enhanced British Telecom partner integrations with FastAPI and Redis microservices, delivering sub-200ms REST responses across 10K+ API calls.

skills.label: SQL
skills.source: Job Summary We are seeking a Data Scientist with expertise in data science and operations research to develop predictive models and optimization solutions. The role focuses on time-series forecasting, machine learning, and improving demand planning across products, regions, and business segments. The Data Scientist will develop SQL-based ETL processes and data pipelines, collaborate with data engineering teams, and establish governance and monitoring practices to ensure model outputs are accurate, explainable, auditable, and production-ready. Key Responsibilities •    Develop and deploy time-series forecasting and machine learning models to improve demand planning across products, regions, and business segments. •    Apply operations research and optimization techniques to improve outcomes using available resources and operational capabilities. •    Develop and maintain SQL-based ETL processes and data pipelines supporting optimization models, scenario analysis, and production deployment. •    Partner with data engineering teams to ensure the quality, availability, and integrity of model inputs. •    Incorporate demand variability, lead times, network structure, service policies, and operational constraints into model inputs and optimization solutions. •    Establish governance, monitoring, and documentation practices to ensure model outputs are accurate, explainable, auditable, and production-ready. Required Qualifications •    Experience in data science, predictive modeling, and machine learning. •    Experience with time-series forecasting and demand planning. •    Knowledge of operations research and optimization techniques. •    Experience developing and maintaining SQL-based ETL processes and data pipelines. •    Ability to collaborate with data engineering teams to maintain data quality, availability, and integrity. •    Understanding of model governance, monitoring, explainability, auditability, and production deployment.

This is a 1-year contract assignment focused on technical analysis, AI Agent automation, AWS production support, monitoring, and observability. The role involves supporting complex integrated systems, troubleshooting production issues, identifying root causes, implementing automated operational workflows, and ensuring data pipelines remain scalable, secure, and efficient. The CDP program uses the Scaled Agile Framework for Enterprises (SAFe) to deliver incremental business value. This position requires a hands-on technical contributor rather than a manager or architect. Key Responsibilities •    Provide primary technical support to end users for software issues, data problems, data communication errors, and processing failures. •    Provide hands-on production support for applications running on Kubernetes and high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution. •    Monitor application production environments and provide technical and user support for new releases and implementations. •    Assess existing production support processes and identify opportunities for automation using AI Agents. •    Design, build, and deploy AWS AI Agents using Amazon Bedrock Agents to automate repetitive support tasks, incident triage, and operational workflows. •    Develop agent skills and action groups for operational use cases such as log analysis, alert correlation, and automated remediation. •    Integrate AI Agents with observability and monitoring tools, including CloudWatch, Grafana, and Container Insights, to enable intelligent responses to production issues. •    Collaborate with support, platform, and application teams to convert manual runbooks and standard operating procedures into automated, agent-driven workflows. •    Ensure AI Agent development and deployment comply with Client's  security, risk, and regulatory requirements, including data handling, model governance, and access controls. •    Work with Databricks data pipelines to provide AI Agents with relevant operational and support data for decision-making. •    Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for agent deployment, versioning, and lifecycle management. •    Document agent architecture, workflows, decision logic, and governance compliance for support teams and auditors. •    Train and transfer knowledge to internal support teams on using, maintaining, and extending AI Agent capabilities. •    Participate in ongoing production support and maintain continuity between manual and automated processes during the transition. •    Consult on application testing strategies, document observations, and coordinate responses. •    Maintain project and application documentation, including schedules, system scope, requirements, and other relevant information. •    Coordinate information flow between business owners and development teams. •    Coordinate tasks, functional reviews, and application development sessions between development sites and technical workgroups, ensuring timely execution. •    Document end-user interactions in automated call-logging tools for tracking and productivity purposes. •    Evaluate proposed technical approaches to system and application problem logs and recommend remediation strategies to management. •    Recommend process improvements and demonstrate creativity in addressing problems, issues, and opportunities. •    Support Agile delivery activities, including requirements engineering, backlog development, and backlog refinement. •    Engage stakeholders and collaborate with distributed teams and software solution providers. •    Apply application and data modeling techniques to identify root causes and recommend appropriate solutions. •    Work effectively across support, platform engineering, security, and end-user teams. •    Provide periodic on-call support during either the 8:00 AM–2:00 PM ET or 2:00 PM–8:00 PM ET shift, Monday through Friday. operational tasks. •    Understanding of prompt engineering, knowledge bases, and agent orchestration within Amazon Bedrock. •    Experience integrating AI Agents with APIs and operational tools. •    Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including Lambda, Bedrock, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, and Step Functions. •    Experience automating AWS production environment tasks, including automated remediation and alert handling. •    Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation for deploying agent and automation infrastructure. •    Experience integrating AI and automation solutions with observability tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, and Container Insights. •    Experience with GitLab CI/CD for automation and agent deployment pipelines. •    Working knowledge of Databricks for data access and integration supporting agent decision-making. •    Understanding of AI/ML governance considerations, including model risk, data privacy, and auditability, particularly in regulated or financial services environments. •    Ability to work within the client's security and compliance framework for AI and automation deployments. •    Experience translating manual support processes and runbooks into automated workflows. •    Strong documentation skills for architecture, agent logic, operational workflows, and governance compliance. •    Ability to train support teams on new automated tools and workflows. •    Hands-on experience providing production support for applications running on Kubernetes and HPC clusters. •    Experience with incident triage, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and production issue resolution. •    Strong experience in Agile delivery, requirements engineering, backlog development, and refinement. •    Strong experience working in an Agile environment using the SAFe framework and tools such as Jira. •    Experience engaging stakeholders and working with distributed teams and software solution providers. •    Broad knowledge of application and data modeling techniques, with the ability to identify root causes and recommend solutions. •    Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and design skills. •    Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and mentor technical and non-technical audiences. •    Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work independently while helping build team capabilities. •    Strong customer service orientation and patience when explaining or simplifying technical concepts. •    Willingness to provide periodic on-call support during the specified weekday shifts. Preferred Qualifications •    Prior experience with Amazon Bedrock, including Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails.

skills.source: Position Summary  We are seeking a Software Developer to support the design, development, modernization, and maintenance of manufacturing and business applications. This role will work closely with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Operations to develop solutions that improve production efficiency, system reliability, traceability, and data visibility across manufacturing operations.  The ideal candidate will have experience with Microsoft development technologies, database-driven applications, application troubleshooting, and software modernization efforts.     Required Education     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.   Required Experience   Minimum 3 years of software development experience.   Experience with .NET Framework and/or .NET Core development.   Experience developing and supporting enterprise applications.       Responsibilities     Develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications, components, tools, and utilities.   Modify software to fix defects, improve performance, and enhance functionality.   Analyze business and manufacturing requirements and develop technical solutions.   Participate in system testing, validation, troubleshooting, and deployment activities.   Work with customers and departments on software design, support, and maintenance.   Consult with stakeholders on project status, technical solutions, and system improvements.   Analyze and recommend enhancements to existing systems or implementation of new solutions.   Support the migration of legacy COM executables and DLLs to modern .NET/.NET Core architectures.   Develop and maintain technical and support documentation.   Troubleshoot application, database, server, and system integration issues.   Support continuous improvement initiatives within manufacturing operations.       Required Technical Skills     .NET Framework / .NET Core   C#   ASP.NET   Visual Studio   SQL Server   MVC   API development and integration   Relational database design and development   Client/server application development   Object-oriented programming principles   Application debugging and troubleshooting   Preferred Technical Skills   Python development and scripting   VB.NET   SSIS   Entity Framework or Dapper   Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF)   IIS   MSMQ   SQL performance tuning   UI design and development   Git, Azure DevOps, or similar source control platforms   Application performance troubleshooting and optimization   Experience integrating applications with manufacturing equipment, databases, or enterprise systems   Manufacturing Experience (Preferred)   Camstar MES or other Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)   Manufacturing application support   Production environment troubleshooting   Manufacturing data collection and reporting systems   Quality, traceability, and process control systems   MES experience, including Camstar, is preferred but not required.       Soft Skills     Ability to work effectively within a small development team.   Strong written and verbal communication skills.   Ability to work directly with manufacturing customers and stakeholders.   Ability to prioritize work across multiple projects and production support activities.   Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.   Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.   Self-motivated with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.   Ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives     Nesco Resource offers a comprehensive benefits package for our associates, which includes a MEC (Minimum Essential Coverage) plan that encompasses Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, and EAP (Employee Assistance Program) services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing data pipelines, AI-driven solutions, and front-end interfaces, alongside streamlining deployment and operational processes through DevOps practices. This role demands a combination of data engineering expertise, AI knowledge, and full stack development skills to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.  Key Responsibilities:  Develop, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and analysis using Python.  Design and implement AI and machine learning models to derive insights and automate processes.  Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using React and TypeScript to visualize data and AI outputs.  Implement DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing to ensure reliable deployment.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, product managers, and developers to deliver end-to-end data solutions.  Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure the scalability and security of data and application systems.  Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering, AI, front-end development, and DevOps      Skills: Digital : Python~Digital : ReactJS~Next JS  Experience Required: 6-8

skills.source: Do something big and innovative! Stretch your creative muscles and work on big issues.  Since 1989, we have developed technology environments, applications, and tools by providing experienced teams to implement, enhance, and maintain our clients’ essential systems and applications.  Come join the Artech team!       Job Title:  GIS Maps – Tools Analyst  Job ID: 26-40477   Location: Austin, TX 78727 | Fully Onsite      Role Summary:     We are seeking a technically skilled Tools Analyst to support GIS automation and data tooling initiatives within the Maps organization.   This role is focused on developing internal tooling to improve workflow efficiency, automate data analysis, and ensure data accuracy across large-scale geospatial datasets.   The ideal candidate has a strong command of scripting languages, experience working with geospatial data, and the ability to identify and analyze patterns across complex data systems.       Core Responsibilities     Design, maintain, and enhance internal tools and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability of GIS and data workflows.   Analyze large, structured datasets to identify trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process or tooling improvements.   Support data quality, validation, and monitoring efforts by evaluating outputs and surfacing systemic issues.   Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate operational needs into practical technical solutions.   Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of tooling, processes, and analytical approaches.       Required Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.   2–3 years of experience working with SQL, Python, HiveQL, and Shell scripting in a data-rich environment.   Proficiency with Unix/Linux command line tools and file handling.   Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret structured data in formats like JSON.   Experience working with large, distributed datasets and extracting insights across complex systems.   Strong organizational and documentation skills, with the ability to track and explain tool functionality clearly.   Ability to work independently and handle shifting project scopes or data priorities.       Preferred Skills:     Experience with QGIS or PostGIS for geospatial analysis and visualization.   Familiarity with data pipeline tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar automation platforms.   Background in GIS QA workflows and understanding of map data accuracy standards.   Prior experience with tooling to support data labeling, machine learning inputs, or prototyping environments.       Why Join Us:     Help build the next generation of GIS tools supporting real-world mapping and navigation products.   Be part of a high-impact team developing automation solutions that scale across global data operations.   Contribute to the advancement of geospatial technologies used by millions of users around the world.   Join a collaborative environment focused on innovation, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.         Please Contact: Angela Luis at 858-800-3007 or  angela.luis@artech.com        http://www.artech.com  Referrals welcome!  Referral bonus up to $1000!  Feel free to reach out for additional details

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Role: Full Stack Engineer Level II  Location: Plano, TX (Preferred); McLean, VA and Richmond, VA are also considered  Contract: 12 Months        Position Overview  Capital One is seeking a hands-on Full Stack Software Engineer to join its Core division's engineering team, which focuses on reducing operational toil by building innovative internal applications, automation solutions, and tools that improve engineering productivity.  This is a fast-paced, backend-focused engineering role requiring strong Python development skills, experience with REST APIs, SQL, AWS, CI/CD, and practical use of AI-assisted development tools. The engineer will work on internal notification and remediation solutions, identify technical problems, develop solutions, and deliver production-ready code quickly.  The ideal candidate is self-driven, adaptable, comfortable working with minimal supervision, and capable of taking ownership of tasks from problem definition through development, testing, deployment, and support.   Key Responsibilities     Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python.   Build and enhance internal engineering tools, notification applications, and automated remediation solutions.   Develop and maintain SQL schemas, datasets, and data pipelines as required by project needs.   Leverage AWS services to develop and support scalable cloud-based applications.   Use AI-assisted coding tools and agentic AI solutions to accelerate development, troubleshoot issues, and improve engineering productivity.   Work with existing MCP servers and integrate available AI capabilities into internal applications and workflows.   Contribute to frontend development using React, with frontend work accounting for a smaller portion of the overall workload.   Implement CI/CD processes and address application vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance requirements.   Troubleshoot application issues, analyze logs, support production systems, and resolve technical problems independently.   Create and maintain observability dashboards using tools such as Splunk, New Relic, or similar monitoring platforms.   Participate in Agile/Kanban ceremonies, daily stand-ups, Jira story tracking, quarterly planning activities, and technical demonstrations.   Collaborate with team members, communicate progress clearly, and provide technical support to unblock others when needed.   Work effectively in a dynamic environment where requirements may evolve and solutions need to be delivered within days or weeks.     Required Skills and Qualifications     Strong hands-on experience in  Python backend development .   Experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.   Working knowledge of  React or similar frontend technologies  and the ability to contribute to frontend development.   Experience with SQL, database schemas, data modeling, and data pipeline development.   Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and familiarity with cloud architecture and terminology.   Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, troubleshooting, and software deployment.   Practical experience using AI-powered development tools, such as Claude Code or comparable AI coding assistants.   Understanding of agentic AI development, AI-powered automation, or integration with existing MCP servers is highly desirable.   Experience with application vulnerability remediation, security findings, and compliance-related engineering tasks.   Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk, New Relic, or similar platforms.   Experience analyzing application logs and resolving production issues.   Previous experience working with Capital One or similar large enterprise engineering environments.   Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, communication skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.   Experience building AI-powered developer productivity tools or agentic AI solutions.     Preferred Qualifications     Familiarity with MCP server integrations and leveraging existing MCP capabilities within applications.   Experience working with Go or maintaining Java-based legacy applications.   Experience building internal engineering tools, notification systems, automated remediation solutions, and operational automation.   Strong presentation skills and the ability to demonstrate completed solutions to technical stakeholders.     Expected Work Distribution     50% – Backend APIs and data:  REST API development, database schemas, datasets, and related data processing.   25% – Security and compliance:  Vulnerability remediation, compliance findings, and related engineering activities.   25% – Frontend and other engineering tasks:  React development, troubleshooting, legacy application maintenance, and production support.    The role is primarily backend-focused. Python is the main development language; Java is being phased out, with any remaining Java work largely limited to maintenance and bug fixes.   Team and Work Environment  The engineer will join a small, collaborative team of approximately 6–8 people. Team members typically own individual tasks but are expected to collaborate, learn quickly, and support colleagues when priorities change.  The team follows a Kanban-based workflow using Jira and conducts regular stand-ups, quarterly planning, and technical demonstrations. Engineers are expected to work with limited documentation, clarify problem statements, iterate quickly, obtain team feedback, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision.  Some production support and monitoring responsibilities may be required, including reviewing logs and resolving issues during the approximate 7:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. support window. This does not imply continuous overnight on-call coverage.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

Key Responsibilities     Design and implement AI-powered solutions using  Snowflake Cortex AI, CoCO, and CoCO Desktop .   Develop and deploy  RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)  applications, AI agents, semantic search solutions, and agentic workflows.   Architect scalable data platforms using  Snowflake, Kafka, Spark, Airflow, dbt, and cloud-native services .   Build and optimize ELT/ETL pipelines for batch and real-time data processing.   Develop enterprise AI applications leveraging LLMs, vector search, and AI orchestration frameworks.   Implement data modeling, semantic layers, governance, security, and performance optimization within Snowflake.   Lead architecture reviews, workshops, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and production deployments.   Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, and customers to translate requirements into scalable solutions.   Create reusable frameworks, accelerators, and best practices for AI and data engineering initiatives.   Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and governance standards. skills.label: Java
skills.source: Job Summary The Java Software Engineer will develop and maintain middleware and web services that connect enterprise systems with customer-facing product lines and business services. The role involves building Java-based applications using Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem, developing and consuming REST APIs, and working with relational databases and cloud-native technologies. The engineer will collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable software solutions while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and development efficiency. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, test, and maintain Java applications using Java 11/17, Spring Boot, and the broader Spring ecosystem. •    Develop, integrate, and consume REST APIs and web services to support middleware and enterprise business services. •    Build and maintain software components that facilitate communication between enterprise systems and customer-facing product lines. •    Work with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms to support application data requirements. •    Develop and maintain applications for cloud environments, with a focus on Microsoft Azure. •    Support containerized application deployments and contribute to migration initiatives from Kubernetes to Azure Container Apps (ACA). •    Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude to improve software development lifecycle activities. •    Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions. •    Participate in application design, code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities. •    Follow software development best practices, coding standards, and established development processes. Required Qualifications •    Strong hands-on experience with Java 11/17. •    Experience developing applications using Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem. •    Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and web services. •    Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies. •    Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. •    Excellent written and verbal communication skills. •    Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services. •    Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Container Apps (ACA), particularly application migration between container platforms. •    Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and cloud-native application deployment. •    Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude. •    Experience supporting middleware, enterprise integrations, or web services for business applications.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

skills.source: Job Summary The Java Software Engineer will develop and maintain middleware and web services that connect enterprise systems with customer-facing product lines and business services. The role involves building Java-based applications using Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem, developing and consuming REST APIs, and working with relational databases and cloud-native technologies. The engineer will collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable software solutions while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and development efficiency. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, test, and maintain Java applications using Java 11/17, Spring Boot, and the broader Spring ecosystem. •    Develop, integrate, and consume REST APIs and web services to support middleware and enterprise business services. •    Build and maintain software components that facilitate communication between enterprise systems and customer-facing product lines. •    Work with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms to support application data requirements. •    Develop and maintain applications for cloud environments, with a focus on Microsoft Azure. •    Support containerized application deployments and contribute to migration initiatives from Kubernetes to Azure Container Apps (ACA). •    Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude to improve software development lifecycle activities. •    Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions. •    Participate in application design, code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities. •    Follow software development best practices, coding standards, and established development processes. Required Qualifications •    Strong hands-on experience with Java 11/17. •    Experience developing applications using Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem. •    Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and web services. •    Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies. •    Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. •    Excellent written and verbal communication skills. •    Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services. •    Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Container Apps (ACA), particularly application migration between container platforms. •    Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and cloud-native application deployment. •    Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude. •    Experience supporting middleware, enterprise integrations, or web services for business applications.

The role focuses on near-term, well-defined automation work while internal team members continue to focus on complex and long-term strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong Python development skills, experience with process and workflow automation, API integrations, databases, and production support. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience with AI-enabled automation.

skills.source: Job Summary The Machine Learning Builder will develop, deploy, and operate production-grade AI, machine learning, and analytical solutions across Claims and Payment Integrity, Customer Service, and Technology workflows within the healthcare domain. unparsed.source: We're looking for people who have already used AI to change how real work gets done.

You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You've built things that other people used, or that ran in production systems, and that measurably improved the speed or quality of their work.

You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new work becomes viable.

You learn the work quickly. You may have direct experience in sales development, sales operations, or marketing, or you quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of a new team. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it.
You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions.
You are a strong communicator. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and make progress visible to leadership and stakeholders.
You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next week.
You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment.
